126086.about: Gale is one of Don Kee's henchmen on the planet Imecka, along with his partner, Sheela, in Dragon Ball GT. Gale is said to be able to take on entire army by himself. However, he looks not very strong compared to Gokuu. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

126087.name: Sheela
126087.about: Sheela is a female Imeckian commissioner, along with her partner, Gale, in Dragon Ball GT. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

126724.name: Midler
126724.about: Midler is a famous Stand user (as Avdol knew about her) hired by Dio to kill the Joestar group, infiltrating her Stand on Mohammed Avdol's submarine to trap them in a closed space. Taking the form of different things, her Stand continuously attacks and escapes from the group, while Midler taunts them talking through her Stand. Eventually trapping them in her own Stand's mouth, Midler claims that her teeth are harder than diamonds and tries to crush Jotaro with them, but instead has her teeth punched out by Star Platinum. Jean Pierre Polnareff, wanting to take a look at her, goes to her convulsing body but says it isn't worth to look, because of her now toothless face. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

127095.name: Ameno
127095.about: Ameno is a kunoichi from Sunagakure and a team-mate of Kouji and Shishio. Ameno is a skilled medical-nin who is able to increase the speed of a body's natural healing process by sending chakra from her hands into a wound on an afflicted body part. She is also able to perform fine minor surgery, removing countless poison barbs from an individual. She can also use Water Release. She commonly applies this skill to supplement her medical skills. With it, she can treat poison-related injuries or act as a contingency plan against enemy attacks, healing herself and others. In actual combat, she can form giant pinchers of water to attack her opponent from a greater distance. (Source: Narutopedia)

127263.name: Ootsutsuki, Indra
127263.about: Manga debut: Chapter #462 Indra Ootsutsuki was the elder son of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki. From a young age, he demonstrated a great aptitude towards ninshuu and anything else he applied his mind to. Due to his prowess, he led a solitary life as he felt no need to depend on others. He is also the ancestor of the Uchiha clan.

127264.name: Ootsutsuki, Ashura
127264.about: Ashura Ootsutsuki was the youngest son of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki and heir to his teachings. He is also the ancestor of the Senju clan, as well as the Uzumaki clan.

127469.name: Gasshu
127469.about: Gasshu is the leader of the Spice Boys, and is Garlic Jr.'s right-hand man during the Garlic Jr. Saga. Gasshu is a formidable warrior in his own right. Being the strongest of the Spice Boys, he possesses frightening speed and ruthlessness, his speed even shocks Gohan. During the Garlic Jr. Saga, he explains the presence of the Makyo Star and its origins. Gasshu knows of Piccolo and Gohan and their past, such as Piccolo's fascination with the dark side and the fact that Gohan managed to defeat Garlic Jr. He is also the only one of the Spice Boys who initially knows everything about the Makyo Star and the Black Water Mist. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

127470.name: Arqua
127470.about: Arqua is East Kai's prodigy student. He is matched against Goku in the third round of the Other World Tournament, where he is met with a rough start. Shortly into the match, Arqua transforms the arena into a water environment, giving him somewhat of an advantage in the battle. He makes his debut in the 197th episode of Dragon Ball Z, "Water Fight", and he is seen again in a cameo in the movie Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

127471.name: Lemuria
127471.about: Lemuria is an Arlian who was married to Atla, but King Moai stole her from him when he imprisoned Atla. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

127474.name: Cell Games Announcer
127474.about: Jimmy Firecracker is the ZTV announcer who gave a play-by-play of the Cell Games. Jimmy Firecracker is presented as an extremely biased and partisan interviewer, as at the start of the Cell Games, he staunchly believes that Mr. Satan is the strongest being on the planet, and downplays the Z Fighters as though they are nothing, particularly Goku, after he tries to warn Mr. Satan that he might get killed by Cell. In spite of his flaws, however, Firecracker is also a rather brave man, shown when he is virtually the only man with enough courage to cover the Cell Games despite the danger of merely being present, and even attempts to interview Cell personally, backing off only when Cell refuses to speak to him. Though gullible like the rest of the majority of the Earth's populace, Firecracker appears to change his opinion about Mr. Satan and the Z Fighters after the tournament, since it took him a while to believe Mr. Satan when the latter claimed he beat Cell single-handedly. In the original Japanese version of the manga and anime, he is not given a name and is only ever referred to as the "Cell Games Announcer". (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

127475.name: Zant, Van
127475.about: Van Zant is a madman character unnamed in the Dragon Ball manga, but named in the anime Dragon Ball Z. First appearing in the Majin Buu Saga, he is a deranged gunman who enjoys killing people (apparently, with the rationale that since it is "the end of the world", he wants to go out with a bang). In the Japanese version and the manga, Smitty refers to him as "young master," implying that Van Zant is from a wealthy family and that Smitty is his butler and/or servant. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

127957.name: Ootsutsuki, Hamura
127957.about: Hamura Ootsutsuki is the son of Princess Kaguya Ootsutsuki‎‎, the fraternal twin brother of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki; both of whom were the first two born with the ability to wield chakra. Hamura was also the ancestor of the Hyuuga clan and the founder of the shinobi of the moon. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

127961.name: Sarutobi, Mirai
127961.about: Mirai Sarutobi is a kunoichi and a member of Konohagakure's Sarutobi Clan. She is the daughter of Asuma and Kurenai.

127963.name: Yamanaka, Inojin
127963.about: Inojin Yamanaka is an Academy student and a member of Konohagakure's Yamanaka Clan.

127964.name: Akimichi, Chouchou
127964.about: Chouchou Akimichi is an Academy student and a member of Konohagakure's Akimichi Clan.

128051.name: Yamaarashi
128051.about: He is a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons.

128188.name: Mitsuki
128188.about: Birthdate: July 25 Zodiac sign: Leo Gender: Male Species: Synthetic Human Height: Gaiden: 149 cm Affiliation: Otogakure Symbol Otogakure Ryūchi Cave Symbol Ryūchi Cave Konohagakure Symbol Konohagakure Team: Team 7 He is a Konohagakure shinobi. He's also a teammate of Boruto Uzumaki and Sarada Uchiha. (Source: Narutopedia)

128531.name: Uchiha, Shin
128531.about: Shin's identity and origins are currently unknown, though Kakashi suggests that he may be a survivor of the Uchiha clan or, more likely, one of Orochimaru's experiments. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

129493.name: Kurama, Unkai
129493.about: A shinobi from Konohagakure and a member of the Kurama clan's branch family.

130328.name: Ootsutsuki, Momoshiki
130328.about: Momoshiki Ootsutsuki was a member of the Ootsutsuki clan and the main antagonist in Boruto: Naruto the Movie. (Source: Narutopedia)

130329.name: Ootsutsuki, Kinshiki
130329.about: Kinshiki was a member of the Ootsutsuki clan, who served as a retainer for his son Momoshiki. (Source: Naruto Wiki)

130361.name: Ajisai
130361.about: In the anime, Ajisai was a kunoichi from Amegakure and a teammate of Suiren and Fuyou.

130462.name: Shisami
130462.about: Shisami is part of Sorbet's elite soldiers, being on par with Tagoma on the position of Sorbet's top-men.

131070.name: Karoni
131070.about: One of Mr. Satan's top students who is a ladies-man attitude and does the Beautiful Flying Rose Attack.

131709.name: Formaggio
131709.about: Formaggio is one of the members of La Squadra di Esecuzione. Just like the rest of the group he wishes to avenge his death comrades, Gelato and Sorbet, by finding the identity of Passione's boss. He is seen as a tough person with a sadistic personality.

131816.name: Zoldyck, Maha
131816.about: Assisted in the assassination of the ten dons. No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

133227.name: Donquixote, Homing
133227.about: Donquixote Homing is the deceased husband of Matriarch and father of Doflamingo and Rosinante. A former World Noble of the Donquixote Family, he withdrew from his position and left Mariejois in order to live a normal life with his family. After living two years of abuse from prejudiced civilians, Homing was killed by his then ten-year old son Doflamingo.

133279.name: Pirozhki
133279.about: Pirozhki is one of Mr. Satan's top two students. He and Caroni are known as one of the greatest tag teams in their pro leagues. Pirozhki is very muscular and powerful but appears to take on a fat appearance. According to himself, he has the world's greatest physical strength. (Source: Wikia)

133890.name: Karin's Mother
133890.about: Karin's Mother was a member of the Uzumaki Clan who lived in Kusagakure. After her home village was destroyed, Karin's mother came to Kusagakure while her daughter was still young. The two were allowed to stay, provided that the mother would use her powers to heal the injured of the village. As a direct descendant of the Uzumaki clan, she had a remarkably powerful life-force, granting her immense vitality, longevity, and healing powers. Even more, she could transmit her healing to anyone who bit her and sucked on her chakra, immediately healing any injury. (Source: Narutopedia)

133934.name: Kazeno, Minoru
133934.about: Minoru is a professional wrestler that appears in the second Chopperman special. He is a large, muscular, very honorable man. (Source: Wikia)

134165.name: Senjuu, Kawarama
134165.about: Kawarama Senju was a young shinobi from the Senju clan. Manga Debut: Chapter #624 Anime Debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #368 (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

134359.name: Champa
134359.about: Champa is the God of Destruction of Universe 6. His name seems to come from "champagne", continuing the alcohol name puns that the Gods of Destruction and their attendants possess. He is Beerus's brother and is thus similar in appearance, but with a plumper build and a shorter tail. He also attains a similar attire but with red instead of blue. Champa seems to be impatient and loves to participate in "food showdowns" with Beerus, where they try to impress the other with tasty food. Champa is introduced with Vados as they destroy planets across Universe 7 in search of a specific one. They meet with Goku, Vegeta, Whis and Beerus after Freeza was killed a second time on Earth; naturally, Champa challenges Beerus to a food showdown and is won over by instant ramen, Earth's "tastiest food". Champa wants Earth (so as to eat as much ramen as he wants; the Earth in his universe was laid waste to by a war waged by humanity) and challenges Beerus to a 5-on-5 battle where they will each hand pick fighters from their respective universes.

134539.name: Mansherry
134539.about: The princess of the Tontatta Tribe who possesses the power of the Chiyu Chiyu no Mi.

135210.name: Toroi
135210.about: Toroi is a shinobi of Kumogakure and a team-mate of Yurui and Tarui, who appears in Boruto: Naruto the Movie.

135211.name: Tarui
135211.about: Tarui is a kunoichi of Kumogakure and a team-mate of Yurui and Toroi, who appears in Boruto: Naruto the Movie.

135212.name: Yurui
135212.about: Yurui is a shinobi of Kumogakure and a teammate of Toroi and Tarui. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

135213.name: Shinki
135213.about: Shinki is a shinobi of Sunagakure's Kazekage clan and a member of Team Shinki. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

135214.name: Yodo
135214.about: Yodo is a kunoichi of Sunagakure. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

135215.name: Araya
135215.about: Araya is a shinobi of Team Shinki. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

135217.name: Lee, Metal
135217.about: Metal Lee is a shinobi of Konohagakure's Lee clan. An academy graduate, a genin-level Metal Lee participated in the Chuunin Exams during the events of Boruto: Naruto the Movie with an unspecified team.

135265.name: Vados
135265.about: Vados is Champa's attendant and the older sister of Whis. She is introduced with Champa as they destroy planets across Universe 7, looking for a specific one. Sometime after Goku kills Freeza, they visit Whis and she watches as Champa and Beerus have a "food showdown". Champa is won over by the tastiness of Earth's instant ramen and Vados regrettably informs him that the Earth in their universe (Universe 6) was laid barren thanks to a war waged by humanity. Champa then challenges Beerus to a 5-on-5 battle where they will handpick fighters from their respective universes. The prize will be Universe 7's Earth!

136281.name: Aoda
136281.about: Birthdate: October 1 Gender: Male Species: Snake Classification: Summon Affiliation: Ryuuchi Cave Aoda is an inhabitant of the Ryuuchi Cave and the personal summon of Sasuke Uchiha. In stark contrast to Manda, a snake of similar size to it, Aoda seems to be very mild mannered and respectful to its summoner, as shown when it addresses Sasuke with the "-sama" suffix and dutifully follows all his orders without needing to be controlled. Aoda also asked Sasuke how he could be of service the instant he was summoned. He was also described as simple. (Source: Narutopedia, edited)

136803.name: Pteranodon
136803.about: Pterodactyls, also called Pteranodons, are huge flying pterosaur reptiles. They live in Mount Paozu, as well as many other places of the Earth. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

136892.name: Joestar, Shizuka
136892.about: A baby found by Joseph on Morioh's streets in Diamond is Unbreakable. When she is frightened, her stand turns her and anything in the vicinity invisible. She is most comfortable around Joseph, who takes a liking to her and adopts her into his family.

136919.name: Toono, Katasuke
136919.about: Katasuke is a tokubetsu jounin of Konohagakure's Science Ninja Weapons Team. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

137260.name: Largo
137260.about: Largo is an anime-only character. He is the captain of the Amigo Pirates. He was offered to become the leader of the 51st division of Shiki's pirate crew, but he needed to fulfill a condition first. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

137552.name: Monaka
137552.about: Monaka is a character whom the God of Destruction Beerus fought at some point in the past. He was the strongest person in the seventh universe whom Beerus had ever fought, leading Beerus to place him on his team in the tournament against Champa's team.

137554.name: Cabba
137554.about: Cabba is a warrior who is selected to be a part of Champa's team against Beerus's in Dragon Ball Super. He is a Saiyan from Universe 6, who are much more benevolent than their Universe 7 counterparts.

137555.name: Frost
137555.about: Frost is a fighter selected on Champa's team for the 5v5 match against Beerus. He is the Universe 6 counterpart of Freeza. He plays the image of a savior to those affected greatly in war-torn regions when in reality he is the one who starts these fights so that he can make money off the land he "saves" and look good to the public.

137556.name: Botamo
137556.about: Botamo is a fighter selected for Champa's team on the 5v5 match he has with Beerus. He is the first to fight Goku and he loses in the first round via ring out. His skin is slick, oily and hairless, and he has an ability to displace all damage he receives somewhere else.

137557.name: Magetta
137557.about: Magetta is a warrior from the sixth universe and is part of Champa's team against Beerus.' Magetta is a member of the Metalman race from Universe 6. Magetta can raise the temperature within his vicinity which can cause the whole area around to become extremely hot. Magetta was able to easily block Vegeta's Galick Gun with his Lava Spit which becomes solidified which can be used as a weapon. Magetta's weight is also so great that not even Super Saiyan Vegeta could lift him. However, one of Magetta's weakness is his low mobilty as he cannot fly. Nevertheless Vegeta himself says it is dangerous to fight him in close quarters, suggesting that he is a great melee fighter. In the manga, Magetta showed himself even more durable, as Vegeta's punches only succeeded in hurting the Saiyan himself. He was also revealed to be over 1,000 tons, making Vegeta even in Super Saiyan form unable to lift him.

137999.name: Nekomamushi
137999.about: Master Nekomamushi is a feline mink and the guardian of the Whale Forest on Zou, dubbed the "Ruler of Night." He rules over the Mokomo Dukedom during the night hours, from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Nekomamushi is the other ruler of the Mokomo Dukedom, alongside Duke Inuarashi, and takes great pride in it by proclaiming the country to be his when the night comes during his first encounter with Jack. Unlike his former friend Inuarashi, Nekomamushi is aggressive and merciless. Inuarashi has described him as an "obstinate and stubborn imbecile," comparing him to Jack himself. Nekomamushi can be stubborn even when not angry, as he kept ignoring Chopper's orders to recuperate in order to have fun. He does not like to be ordered around, as shown when he stated that he went to bed of his own volition rather than on Chopper's orders, and describes himself as a "freedom-loving man." Despite his bravado, he is shown to be afraid of needles. He took care of Bepo and the other Heart Pirates when they arrived on Zou, indicating a welcoming personality.. He does not expect guests to help him defend Zou. However, he does not look kindly upon intruders, going so far as to devour them if he ever sees one. Just like a cat, he likes to lick his paws, play with balls and cat toys, and eat catnip. Unlike most cats, however, he loves taking baths. His favourite food is lasagne

138237.name: Jack
138237.about: Jack is a leading member of Beasts Pirates and is one of the three beings called "The Calamaties" under the yonko Kaidou. He is also the commander of his own ship "Mammoth." Jack is shown to be very ruthless, fearless and has a very violent personality. He refuses to solve any matter through talking and would attack anyone, even his own subordinates, if they were to fail, without mercy. In his own words, he loves destruction. Jack is man of massive standing and is an Ancient zoan type devil fruit user. He ate the Zou Zou no Mi, Model: Mammoth. Jack has a bounty of 1,000,000,000 Beli.

138269.name: Michael
138269.about: Michael and his partner in crime Hoichael are two kids who are troublemakers in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his "Mm, super!!" motto as their own. They also idolize Paulie. However, their backstreet delinquency has earned them ire from at least Tilestone and Peeply Lulu. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

138270.name: Hoichael
138270.about: Hoichael and his partner in crime Michael are two kids who are troublemakers in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his "Mm, super!!" motto as their own. They also idolize Paulie. However, their backstreet delinquency has earned them ire from at least Tilestone and Peeply Lulu. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

138959.name: Hit
138959.about: Hit is a warrior of an unknown race and an esteemed hitman from Universe 6, he is over 1000 years old as well. His signature technique is the Time Skip. He was the last fighter from Champa's team in the Tournament of Destroyers. It was unlike him to join an event like the Tournament of Destroyers becuase of his secluded lifestyle. He agreed to take part in the tournament because Vados offered to give him a cube that would allow him to travel between universes. Hit is first portrayed to be an impassive and silent person who only speaks when needed. During the TOD he rarely got up from his seat in the stands and always had his eyes closed because he was only there to get the cube. During the earlier parts of the tournament Hit eliminates Frost and then Vegeta showing little remorse or empathy for either of them. His biggest fight was with Goku, who was a complete opposite to him because of Goku's playful and talkative nature. Hit started to show that he was having some fun because he started to toy with him as Goku tried to figure out how his time skip worked, but he still did not see Goku as someone worth his time. Once Goku was able to predict Hit's time skips he provided Hit with a fight that he had not experienced in a long time. Hit was pushed beyond his limits as a martial artist because of Goku. Hit showed much more emotion than he usually does during this fight, it was a turning point for his character as he started to respect Goku and also wanted to become a stronger m

138964.name: Zunoo
138964.about: Zunoo is a mysterious character who knows everything in the universe.

138973.name: Gingaou
138973.about: The Galactic King is the king of the Milky Way Galaxy. While there are others who claim ownership of the galaxy such as the tyrant Frieza, this king could be considered the official king of the Milky Way Galaxy as he tries to keep order and protect everyone with the Galactic Patrol working under him.

139848.name: Uchiha, Izumi
139848.about: Izumi Uchiha was a kunoichi from Konohagakure and a member of the Uchiha Clan. She was a friend of Itachi Uchiha since their childhood and deeply cared about him, being so close to him as to be seen as his lover. (Source: Narutopedia)

140169.name: Carrot
140169.about: Age: 15 Birthdate: May 24, Gemini Height: 161 cm (5'3") Blood type: F Affiliation: Inuarashi Musketeer Squad Devil fruit: None Carrot is a rabbit mink in the Warrior Beast Tribe, a member of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, and a ruler's aide. She is extremely fast and strong. She likes carrots and has a extremely outgoing personality. Carrot is a white-furred, blonde-haired rabbit mink and has a humanoid body with rabbit ears, a rabbit-like nose, and a large round tail.

140212.name: Nijimura, Father
140212.about: The father of Okuyasu and Keichou Nijimura. According to the 2017 live-action movie, his name is Mansaku (万作).

141140.name: Zenou
141140.about: The Omni-King is a very small humanoid figure. He has a rather blank expression on his face and has purple and blue stripes on his face as well. He also has no nose present. He wears a pink vest on his body and on the front has two "omni" kanjis (全) present. His head has a rather lemon like shape, with his two ears being pointed and grey.

141344.name: Tanaka
141344.about: Tanaka is a man of average height, standing about as tall as Luffy, with a disproportionately large head and disproportionately smaller legs. He wears a black suit with a green bow tie as well as a white stripe on the left side. A black and white hood covers two horn-shaped appendages on his head, and there is a green star on the hood. Being responsible for security on Gran Tesoro, Mr. Tanaka is trusted by Gildo Tesoro to keep the ship safe. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

141393.name: Jispa
141393.about: First appears in front of Nickes' recruitment team with the new recruits. The best fighter in the alliance.

141729.name: Gokuu Black
141729.about: In the future, he arrives on Earth and goes on a rampage, leaving humanity on the brink of extinction. He encounters Trunks and easily defeats him. Trunks survives their encounter and, for one year and half, prepares to travel back in time using a Time Machine with Bulma in an attempt to save the future. Trunks and Bulma are eventually intercepted by Gokuu Black himself when the villain kills Bulma and destroys their hideout. Trunks narrowly escapes with enough fuel for a one-way trip back to the past while Gokuu Black pursues him. Gokuu Black appears again and attacks Mai and taunts Trunks. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

141734.name: Bill
141734.about: Bill, a "Smelting Man" who ate the Gutsu-Gutsu fruit. He is the Silver Pirate Alliance's leader who is after Luffy. (Source: ANN)

141735.name: Desire
141735.about: Desire, a female pirate who wears a biker gang jacket. She has a connection to Bartolomeo. (Source: ANN)

141736.name: Peseta
141736.about: Peseta, one of the leaders of the Silver Pirate Alliance who adores Bill. (Source: ANN)

141737.name: Abellon
141737.about: Abellon, a "Rail Car Man" who ate the "Korokoro" fruit ("koro-koro" is the sound of a small round object rolling). He corners Luffy with his attacks. (Source: ANN)

142084.name: Vito
142084.about: Vito is a member of the Firetank Pirates, working as the crew's advisor

142182.name: Potage
142182.about: Potage is the only current inhabitant of Planet Potaufeu. He also possesses the key for the seal of Commeson, determined to protect it from the invaders believing the false "Superhuman Water" rumors. Potage has the appearance of an old man, due to being at least 100 years old. He has a large beard covering most of his face, with a bald head and gray sideburns. He wears a sort of yellow protective suit of some sort, with yellow boots and sort of light brown pants as garments, most likely as a defense against invaders. His skin is a light blue color, with a sort of brown color covering on his eyes. Potage is a very noble character. For most of his life, he has done the honorable thing and protected his planet and the universe from the threat of Commeson. Unlike other fighters, he has a rather happy personality, as he went so far as hugging Monaka, a simple deliveryman, when he saw him. Although he has many noble traits, he is shown to be somewhat egotistical as he gloated about his protection of the universe from Commeson. He is shown to be fearful when he fights an opponent or opponents that are stronger than him, as he is seen quivering when Gryll and his henchmen begin to attack. He is also very informed about the history of his planet and Commeson, due to being its sole protector. Potage is not used to seeing such powerful fighters, as he is in complete shock when Trunks and Goten make quick work of Gyrll's henchmen.

142324.name: Edward, Weevil
142324.about: Edward Weevil, or "Whitebeard Jr.," is the self-proclaimed son of Edward Newgate and one of the Shichibukai. Unlike his self-proclaimed father, Weevil does not hold concepts of family in the same regard, believing that his alleged blood heritage is what makes him true family, not bonds built on friendship and camaraderie. Because of this, he violently attacked all those once affiliated with Whitebeard. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

142529.name: Vinsmoke, Reiju
142529.about: The only known daughter of the Vinsmoke Family, making her both a princess of the Germa Kingdom and a commander in its military arm, Germa 66. She is Sanji's and Yonji's older sister.

142805.name: Tsuji, Aya
142805.about: Aya Tsuji is a talented esthetician who won her cosmetic certificate in England, inspired by Cinderella's story, and won many cosmetic contests around the world. She opens a beauty salon called Cinderella in Morioh and, with her Stand Cinderella, helps women to bring love.

142900.name: Tesoro, Gild
142900.about: Gild Tesoro is a man with slicked-back green hair who wears a pink suit and pants. He has a very large star-shaped scar on his back and is the Casino King who is in charge of Gran Tesoro, the largest entertainment city in the world.

143154.name: Zamasu
143154.about: Zamasu is the Supreme Kai apprentice of Universe 10. Zamasu is noted to have similar ki to "Goku Black", and is in someway connected to him. (Source: Dragonball Wikia)

143177.name: Wanda
143177.about: Wanda is a canine mink of the Warrior Beast Tribe, a member of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, and a ruler's aide.

143178.name: Pedro
143178.about: Pedro of the Treetops is a jaguar mink and captain of the Guardians. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

143182.name: Vinsmoke, Yonji
143182.about: Fourth son of the Vinsmoke family and prince of the Germa kingdom. He is Sanji and Reiju's younger brother

143183.name: Charlotte, Praline
143183.about: Praline is a half hammerhead shark mermaid and the 29th daughter of the Charlotte family. She is married to Aladine of the Sun Pirates.

143510.name: Kinoto, Masazo
143510.about: Masazo is a quiet and timid architect, but a little greedy. His Stand, Cheap Trick, constantly keeps him afraid, telling Masazo he would die if anyone saw his back.

143511.name: Miyamoto, Terunosuke
143511.about: Terunosuke is obsessed with fear. The only reason he attacks people is because he wants to see their sign of fear. He sees people as objects. His stand is Enigma.

143844.name: Future Trunks
143844.about: Well-mannered, serious and very cautious, Trunks hails from an alternate timeline in which Future Androids 17 and 18 murdered the Dragon Team and proceeded to create an apocalyptic anarchy on Earth. Trunks is trained by Future Gohan as a teenager and becomes a gifted fighter, swordsman and a Super Saiyajin. Trunks is the son of Bulma and Vegeta. Half Saiyajin and half human, just like Gohan and Goten. Trunks was surrounded by a scientific environment. Having his mother and grandfather as scientists, he became very intelligent at science. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

143896.name: Gowasu
143896.about: Gowasu is a Supreme Kai from Universe 10 and Zamasu's master.

144599.name: Kawajiri, Shinobu
144599.about: Shinobu Kawajiri is a character appearing in Diamond Is Unbreakable. She is a housewife and the mother of Hayato. Shinobu has light brown hair that is parted to the right and tied back in low ponytail. Sometimes, like in her first appearance, she will tie back several locks of hair that are part of her bangs. She wears several different outfits throughout the series, most of them having skirts and patterns such as polka-dots. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Adventure Wikia)

144626.name: Gimlet
144626.about: Gimlet was the late, infant son of Senor Pink and Russian. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

144879.name: Inuarashi
144879.about: Duke Inuarashi is a canine mink and one of the two rulers of the Mokomo Dukedom, dubbed the "Ruler of Day" as he rules over the Mokomo Dukedom from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. He and Nekomamushi serve as retainers for the Kozuki Family of Wano Country. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

145291.name: Future Mai
145291.about: Future Mai is Mai from Future Trunks' timeline. She is the leader of the Resistance against Goku Black. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

145701.name: Agon
145701.about: Agon was examinee #281 in the 287th Hunter Examination. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

145703.name: Mimizu
145703.about: Worm was a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

145704.name: Yama Inu
145704.about: Rabid Dog was a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

145748.name: Hishita
145748.about: Hishita is a male butler of the Zoldyck Family. Hishita first appears when Gon, Kurapika and Leorio come to Kukuroo Mountain to free Killua from the control of his family. He along with the other butlers, meets them at the butlers' mansion and then plays a guessing game with the uninvited guests in which Canary's life is at stake. Later, Killua contacts Canary to have her get Hishita to send cars to three locations he specified, including one near the hospital where Gon is recuperating. Hishita waits for Killua and Alluka at the designated location and he is told to drive to the hospital 60 kilometers away. When Illumi's Needle Humans confront the Hishita, Killua, and Alluka, Killua orders Hishita to get them out of there. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wiki)

145749.name: Kyuu
145749.about: Kyuu is participant #105 in the 287th Hunter Examination. Kyuu is one of the 24 Examinees to make it to the 4th phase of the Hunter Exam on Zevil Island. His badge is the designated target of Pokkle, who paralyzes him with one of his poisoned arrows then takes the badge. Seeing him lying helpless on the ground, Gon bandages him and moves him to a place where he can wait safely until the effects of the poison disappear. Kyuu appears again in this arc to take the 288th Hunter Examination only to fail, by being knocked out by Killua. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

145750.name: Inari, Shinko
145750.about: She has appeared in itachi shinden episode 453 that is her only appearnce.

145888.name: Matthew
145888.about: Matthew was an applicant for the 287th Hunter Examination. Matthew overhears the instructions of the Captain to Gon and his friends in Dolle Harbor and stalks them. On the way, they are forced to stop in a desolated alley by the Quizzing Lady and a bunch of masked people. The old lady asks them a dilemmatic quiz, for them to answer in 5 seconds only. Matthew suddenly steps in and volunteers to answers first in order for him to set traps. He gives the old lady his answer and in return the lady lets him through; however, the path is false, and, according to Kurapika, Matthew is attacked and possibly killed by a monster. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wikia)

145889.name: Hiru
145889.about: Leech was a member of the Shadow Beasts, the elite guard of the Ten Dons. (Source: Hunter x Hunter Wiki)

146113.name: Galbi
146113.about: Galbi is Planet Snak's hero. He travels to Earth to challenge Mr. Satan because he believes he beat the God of Destruction Beerus. As the ambassador of Planet Snak hands Mr. Satan the Hero's Medal, Galbi interjects and wishes to test Satan's power. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

146840.name: Geppuman
146840.about: Geppuman is a cowardly cheapskate who repeatedly eats at restaurants and leaves without paying. He loves eating and running on the bill so much that he describes it as his life, stating that he wants to be able to continue doing it without getting caught. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

146909.name: Vinsmoke, Ichiji
146909.about: First son of the Vinsmoke family.

146917.name: Vinsmoke, Niji
146917.about: Second son of the Vinsmoke family. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

146998.name: Chino
146998.about: Chino is one of the surviving members of the Chinoike Clan, Chino was kidnapped by En Oyashiro, who had been collecting shinobi in possession of a kekkei genkai when she was very young to the point where she forgot her parents' faces. He raised her into a merciless and vengeful shinobi, giving her the task of capturing other kekkei genkai users and eliminating threats. Upon learning her entire clan had been wiped out by enemies and angered by the mistreatment from En, Chino flees from him and sets out on her own path. Along the way, she meets Nowaki. The two then band together and travel together, robbing rich people of their goods for themselves to survive. However, Chino was not able to let go of her hatred towards the villages, which she blames for allowing her clan to perish. In the anime version, however, Chino met Nowaki (who is really Fuushin) when she fought and defeated him during her debut at the Coliseum. They bonded over their loneliness of being ostracised for their abilities and having no families. It was Chino's desire to find her clan at the Valley of Hell that prompted the escape of herself, Fūshin, Karyū, and two others. They formed the Lightning Group and began stealing money for the poor villages before being betrayed when Kirigakure began interfering. The group dissolved with Chino and Fūshin the only ones left. Upon reaching Valley of Hell and seeing it empty with evidence of her clan being dead, Chino vowed revenge for her clan's demise.

147066.name: Raizou
147066.about: Raizou of the Mist is a ninja from Wano Country a comrade of Kinemon and Kanjuurou, and a retainer of the Kouzuki Family. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

147444.name: Tenji
147444.about: Tenji was the emperor of the Land of Ancestors. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

147893.name: Inaho
147893.about: Inaho is a genin from Konohagakure. Like her teammates, she is overconfident in her and her team's abilities to the point where she thought Team Ajisai fled because they were too powerful, which wasn't the case. She fights using explosive tags in tandem with kunai.

148381.name: Gryll
148381.about: Gryll is a wanted criminal in the Milky Way Galaxy from Planet Saute who aimed to obtain the Superhuman Water of Planet Potaufeu. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

148398.name: Shachi
148398.about: Shachi is one of the members of the Heart Pirates. Not much is known about him yet. Like Penguin, he likes women, seems to be a pleasant man, and is loyal to his captain, Law. As a teenager, he was a bully who was prone to mocking people and picking fights, and seemed to respect strength, as he joined up with Law after the latter beat up him and Penguin. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

148399.name: Penguin
148399.about: Penguin is one of the members of the Heart Pirates. Not much is known about him yet. Like Shachi, he likes women, and is loyal to his captain, Law. As a teenager, he was a bully who was prone to mocking people and picking fights, and seemed to respect strength, as he joined up with Law after the latter beat up him and Shachi. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

148695.name: Hinoko
148695.about: Hinoko is a Konohagakure Anbu. She strongly prefers to go by her codename: Soku (鏃, Soku). Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #489 Light Novel debut: Shikamaru Hiden: A Cloud Drifting in Silent Darkness (Source: Narutopedia)

149340.name: All-Hunt, Grount
149340.about: Formerly a subordinate under Aokiji. Only appears in the Marine Rookie Arc.

149345.name: Amaguri, Cocoa
149345.about: Cocoa is a pop Idol that was picked to play the role of damsel in distress in the Great Saiyaman vs Mr. Satan film. She overhears Gohan and Bulma conversation and learned that Gohan was secretly Great Saiyaman. She offers her silence in exchange for a fly around the city and also for her to practice a scene with him. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

149421.name: Akame, Iwana
149421.about: Iwana is a chuunin of Konohagakure. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

149422.name: Bekkou
149422.about: Bekkou is a chuunin from Konohagakure. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

149423.name: Ibara
149423.about: Ibara is a citizen of Konohagakure and the mother of one of the students in Naruto Uzumaki's class at the Academy. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

149424.name: Tsubaki
149424.about: Tsubaki was the mother of one of the students in Naruto's class at the Ninja Academy. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

149773.name: Vinsmoke, Judge
149773.about: Vinsmoke Judge is the king of the Germa Kingdom, a skilled scientist, the supreme commander of the Germa 66, and the patriarch of the Vinsmoke Family.

149813.name: Charlotte, Pudding
149813.about: Charlotte Pudding is the 35th daughter of the Charlotte Family and a hybrid between a human and a member of the Three-Eye Tribe. She works as a chocolatier and the owner of cafe "Caramel" on Cacao Island, and is Vinsmoke Sanji's arranged fiancée, per the political agreement between their families. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

149826.name: Kawaki
149826.about: Gender: Male Age: 14 Height: 157 cm, Timeskip: 183cm Kawaki is a young man with grey eyes and bushy black hair, the sides of which are shaven and blond in colour. Additionally, he has a tattoo of the Roman numeral Ⅸ under his left eye, a pair of piercings on his right eyebrow, and stud earrings. Kawaki wears a green shirt with a blue sleeveless vest jacket with grey stripe patterns on the collar and dark pants with a studded belt. He has a Kāma on the palm of his left hand in the shape of a diamond, which spreads across the left half of his face, chest, and arm, glowing red upon activation. Kawaki is shown to be highly aggressive and vulgar to people he dislikes or opposes. At the same time, he can remain calm and collected when questioning strangers. When not letting his temper get the best of him, Kawaki is shown to be very observant and problematic, easily reading the flow of battle before him and how best to react. (Source: Narutopedia)

149828.name: Kaminarimon, Denki
149828.about: Denki is a Konohagakure genin, and the heir to the Kaminarimon Company. He is a member of Team 5. (Source: Narutopedia)

150100.name: Kakei, Sumire
150100.about: Sumire is an Academy student from Konohagakure, and a representative of her Academy class. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

150101.name: Yuino, Iwabee
150101.about: Iwabee is a Konohagakure genin. While a standout during his entire time enrolled in the Academy, his poor academic test grades lead him to be held back repeatedly. He is a member of Team 5 along with Metal Lee and Denki Kaminarimon. On the day of the Seventh Hokage's inauguration, Iwabee watched the event beside other villagers. Dreaming of becoming a mighty and famous ninja, Iwabee soon enrolled in the Academy. While consistently scoring top marks in all his various ninja classes, his aversion/dislike of book studies not related to ninjutsu but still curriculum-required lead him to get equal consistence poor written grades. This made him fail the graduation exams twice and ultimately forgotten by his former friends who went on to become full-fledged ninja. Blaming the new shinobi era's pursuit of both studies and physical skills for him being held back, Iwabee became rebellious. He would regularly skip classes completely and become harsh if not confrontational with the younger students. (Source: Narutopedia)

150114.name: Vermoud
150114.about: Vermoud is the God of Destruction of Universe 11.

150282.name: Marcarita
150282.about: Marcarita is the Angel of Universe 11.

150483.name: Epoida
150483.about: Epoida is an infamous New World pirate who allied with Whitebeard and fought at the Summit War.

150557.name: Charlotte, Amande
150557.about: Amande is a daughter of the Charlotte Family and a member of the Big Mom Pirates, serving as Totto Land's Mininster of Nuts. She is a hybrid between a human and a member of the Snakeneck Tribe.

150753.name: Caulifla
150753.about: Caulifla is a Saiyan from Universe 6 and a member of Team Universe 6 who will participate in Zen-Oh's Tournament of Power. She is the younger sister of Renso and the leader of a group of Saiyan punks. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

150769.name: Jiren
150769.about: Jiren the Gray is a member of the Pride Troopers, a Superhero team from Universe 11 that participates in the Tournament of Power. He is described by the Troopers leader, Toppo, to be the strongest man in Universe 11. Whis goes as far as saying that Jiren is a mortal which even a God of Destruction can't defeat. Jiren's home-village was attacked by an evil-doer back when he was a kid, causing the death of his parents. Jiren was rescued by a man who later became his teacher. As Jiren grew stronger, he gained new companions. Eventually, the evil-doer returned. Jiren and his companions thought they could win, but were ultimately defeated, along with Jiren's own teacher. Jiren tried to rise again, but was abandoned by the fellow surviving students he always trusted. Jiren realized that the weak could do nothing but obey the strong, which is the reason for Jiren's obsession with power.

150775.name: Charlotte, Katakuri
150775.about: Age: 48 Height: 509 cm (16'8") Affiliations: Big Mom Pirates; Charlotte Family Devil fruit: Mochi-Mochi no Mi (type: Paramecia) Bounty: 1,057,000,000 Beli Charlotte Katakuri is the second son of the Charlotte Family and one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates as well as Totto Land's Minister of Flour, governing over Wheat Island. Katakuri has a very serious, no-nonsense demeanor, caring greatly about his crew and family's objectives. With his heightened Kenbunshoku Haki allowing him to see a little bit into the future and make smart judgment calls, he is dedicated to efficiently dealing with all possible threats within his vicinity and is thus among the few Charlotte children that can be seen taking action without instructions from Big Mom herself. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

150835.name: Renso
150835.about: Renso is a Saiyan from Universe 6. He is a retired captain of the Sadla Defence Forces and the mentor of Cabba. He is also the older brother of Caulifla. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

150836.name: Bergamo
150836.about: Bergamo, also known as "Bergamo The Crusher," is a member of Trio De Dangers, a team of brother fighters from Universe 9. He is the eldest brother of the trio. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

150922.name: Daishinkan
150922.about: An angel that resides at Zen-Oh's Palace. The Great Priest is a short man with pale blue skin, purple eyes, and slicked back white hair. The Great Priest has a blue halo on the back of his head and wears a dark green outfit with an orange triangle on his shirt. On his belt is the kanji symbol for "Grand." The Great Priest is calm and polite, still most of his personality still remains unknown, and mysterious. He has an easygoing personality, not as stern as Zen-Oh's attendants.

150927.name: Zeus
150927.about: Zeus is a thundercloud homie that Big Mom summons from her left hand. It is a special kind of homie, as it received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

150928.name: Prometheus
150928.about: Prometheus is a sun homie that Big Mom summons from her right hand. It is a special kind of homie, as it received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

150930.name: Napoleon
150930.about: Napoleon is a homie taking the form of a bicorne hat that is worn by Big Mom. It is a special kind of homie, as it received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

150933.name: Rabiyan
150933.about: Rabiyan is a flying carpet homie that is often seen with Charlotte Pudding. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

150934.name: Randolph
150934.about: "Crane Rider" Randolph is a rabbit homie and a member of the Big Mom Pirates, having been given a human soul by Big Mom's Devil Fruit power. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

150938.name: Charlotte, Moscato
150938.about: Charlotte Moscato was the 16th son of the Charlotte Family, who served as Totto Land's Minister of Gelato. He was killed by his mother, Charlotte Linlin, during one of her craving-induced rampages. Moscato had a thick torso with comparatively thin arms and legs. His face was long and unshaven, and he had pink and blue hair slicked upward at the front. He wore a dark blue jacket with tasseled, ice cream-shaped pauldrons and a thick belt with his initials, "SM" printed on the buckle over a striped suit. As the Minister of Gelato, Moscato was in charge of procuring and distributing gelato to whoever needed it, and had authority over an unknown island of Totto Land. He was able to jump back and dodge one of his mother's punches, though he was otherwise powerless to stop her rampage. Moscato carried a long sword with a handle shaped like an ice cream cone on his back. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

151073.name: Madoka, Tentou
151073.about: Tento is the heir to the Land of Fire's current daimyou: Ikkyuu Madoka. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

151211.name: Charlotte, Opera
151211.about: Opera is the fifth son of the Charlotte Family, who serves as Totto Land's Minister of Whipped Cream. He is also a member of the Big Mom Pirates. Opera is an enormous man with an extremely thick body. His head and arms are covered in a semi-liquid substance, which composes a very large beard. He wears a bow tie on his beard, as well as a cape with a high collar. He also wears dotted wristlets and a dotted belt which has the same substance dripping from it. His legs are extremely small in comparison to the rest of his body. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

151212.name: Charlotte, Mont-d'Or
151212.about: Mont-d'Or is the 19th son of the Charlotte Family and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Cheese, governing over Cheese Island. He is also a member of the Big Mom Pirates. Mont-d'Or is a lanky man with long limbs and a stocky abdomen. He has a rounded chin that sticks out, a long pointed nose, and a predominant slouch. He wears an open-chested, dark-colored jumpsuit with a skeleton pattern following the limbs and ribs. He also wears a dark-colored top hat with a light pink colored ribbon, as well as dark lipstick and eye makeup in the shape of a single line going down each eyelid. His appearance is reminiscent of a child's skeleton Halloween costume. Mont-d'Or is very fearful of Charlotte Linlin. Mont-d'Or is also somewhat rude. He is very suspicious, and even doesn't trust his older brother. He also seems quite authoritative, as he held and led a meeting with his brothers and sisters, and some Big Mom pirates and also gave orders to his underlings, disregarding what Opera said. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

151214.name: Charlotte, Galette
151214.about: Galette is the eighteenth daughter of the Charlotte Family and serves as Totto Land's Minister of Butter. She is also a member of the Big Mom Pirates. Galette is a woman of average size, with fuchsia hair, shoulder-length, that curls at the ends, and light brown eyes. She wears a short light dress, a dark feather coat, black gloves, and two horns on the top of her head. She has notably thick eyelashes. Galette cares about her family. She is prone to underestimating and condescending others. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

151238.name: Yamaoka
151238.about: Yamaoka is a vassal of the Land of Fire's daimyou, Ikkyuu Madoka. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

151239.name: Shojoji
151239.about: Shojoji is a missing-nin and the leader of Mujina Bandits. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

151302.name: de Chateau, Brianne
151302.about: Brianne de Chateau is a warrior from Universe 2.

151303.name: Lavender
151303.about: Lavender is a member of Trio De Dangers, a team of fighters from Universe 9. He is the middle brother of the trio.

151305.name: Toppo
151305.about: Toppo is the leader of the hero team, Pride Troopers, guardians of peace within Universe 11.

151307.name: Kale
151307.about: Kale is a Saiyan from Universe 6 and a member of team Universe 6. She is a member of Caulifla's gang. She is often looked down upon by the Saiyans of Universe 6, in particular Cabba, who often chews her out for being too nervous. Cabba soon instructs Kale on how to unleash her anger in order to access the Super Saiyan form. However, due to Kale's pent-up stress, she is able to utilize a "berserker" state of the form. (Source: Dragon Ball Wikia)

151783.name: Tayori
151783.about: Tayori is a postman of Konohagakure's Central Post Office. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

152523.name: Scorpion
152523.about: Scorpion is a bounty hunter who lives in the Badland in Alabasta after retiring there to raise his two sons, Chip and Dip, and a passionate man who dedicated himself to try and capture Ace. Scorpion is a middle aged man, with brown hair and a beard. He has a black helmet with a red scorpion mark and an arrowed-heart tattoo on his forehead. He wears a squared red shirt, black long-sleeved undershirt, knee-length overalls with pants underneath, and brown shoes. The Prescorraci Rifle is Scorpion's personal weapon. It is a backpack weapon that can shoot acid from its target hose. Ace manages to escape the acid shot at him, but it is shown to be powerful enough to break through rock. He can also shoot a very strong bomb, that, upon contact with a surface, will protrude spikes from its shell to stick to the surface before detonating. He also has a steel net that can be shot out of his bazooka. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

152575.name: Shigaraki, Tanuki
152575.about: Tanuki was a researcher of Root. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

152800.name: Cus
152800.about: Cus is the Angel of Universe 10. She is also the attendant and martial arts teacher of Rumsshi. She is a child of Great Priest.

152902.name: Charlotte, Brûlée
152902.about: Charlotte Brûlée is the eighth daughter of the Charlotte Family, a member of the Big Mom Pirates, and a major antagonist of the Whole Cake Island Arc.

153054.name: Loggins
153054.about: He, Along with Messina, was a Ripple Master serving Lisa Lisa to train Joseph Joestar and Caesar Anthonio Zeppeli. He was known to be very harsh and demanding when training, as is commented by Joseph.

153725.name: Charlotte, Cracker
153725.about: Charlotte Cracker is the tenth son of the Charlotte Family. He serves as Totto Land's Minister of Biscuit, governing Biscuits Island, and is also one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates.

153794.name: Charlotte, Perospero
153794.about: Charlotte Perospero is the eldest son of the Charlotte Family, a member of the Big Mom Pirates, and Totto Land's Minister of Candy, governing over Candy Island.

153795.name: Charlotte, Chiffon
153795.about: Charlotte Chiffon is the 22nd daughter of the Charlotte Family. She is Capone Bege's wife and the mother of Pez. Her father is one of Big Mom's ex-husbands, Pound, and her younger twin sister is Lola.

153796.name: Pound
153796.about: Pound is one of Big Mom's ex-husbands and the father of Charlotte Chiffon and Lola.

153799.name: Gotty
153799.about: Gotty is an assassin in the Fire Tank Pirates.

153825.name: Sheepshead
153825.about: Sheepshead is the headliner of the Gifters in the Beasts Pirates.

153826.name: Ginrummy
153826.about: Ginrummy is a member of the Gifters in the Beasts Pirates.

153827.name: Roddy
153827.about: Roddy is a bull mink and a Guardian of the Whale Forest.

153828.name: Bariete
153828.about: Bariete is a monkey mink who guards the gates of the Mokomo Dukedom.

153829.name: Sicilian
153829.about: Sicilian is a lion mink and the captain of the Inuarashi Musketeer Squad, as well as one of the Three Inuarashi Musketeers leading the squad.

153830.name: Quitela
153830.about: Quitela is the God of Destruction of Universe 4. He is accompanied by his attendant and martial arts teacher Cognac.

154010.name: Basil
154010.about: Basil is the youngest member of the Trio De Dangers. He forms a team with his brothers Lavender and Bergamo. He was first shown fighting against Majin Buu in the Zen Exhibition Match, which was two days before the actual Tournament of Power, in which his Universe did not perform well. Basil and his brothers perform best when they fight alongside each other, executing unique moves such as the Danger Triangle.

154059.name: Blackback
154059.about: Blackback is a gorilla mink and a Guardian of the Whale Forest.

154060.name: Yomo
154060.about: Yomo is a sheep mink and one of Inuarashi's Musketeers.

154062.name: Miyagi
154062.about: Miyagi is a goat mink and one of Inuarashi's subjects.

154064.name: Milky
154064.about: Milky is a reindeer mink and a member of the Guardians.

154130.name: Baum, King
154130.about: King Baum is a tree homie and the master of the Seducing Woods on Whole Cake Island. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

154250.name: de Bonham, Ant
154250.about: Ant de Bonham is a member of the Longarm Tribe and a Marine who only appeared in the filler Marine Rookie Arc. He was formerly a subordinate under Aokiji.

154252.name: Shu
154252.about: Shu was one of the Marine captains that helped in the Buster Call on Enies Lobby.

154255.name: Sancrin
154255.about: Sancrin is a member of the Longarm Tribe and Brook's former manager.

154256.name: Bunny, Joe
154256.about: Bunny Joe is a member of the Revolutionary Army and the leader of the group that rescued people of Tequila Wolf from slavery along with Nico Robin. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

154258.name: Charlotte, Smoothie
154258.about: Charlotte Smoothie is the 14th daughter of the Charlotte Family and one of the Three Sweet Commanders of the Big Mom Pirates. She also serves as Totto Land's Minister of Juice. She is a hybrid between a human and a member of the Longleg Tribe. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

154259.name: Cosette
154259.about: Cosette is the head chef employed in the Germa Kingdom's royal household.

154260.name: Epony
154260.about: Epony is a nurse in service to the royal household of the Germa Kingdom. She was primarily charged with caring for the late queen, Vinsmoke Sora. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

154263.name: Buhichuck
154263.about: Buhichuck was the boss of the "surprise zombies" in the dining room.

154264.name: Kuween
154264.about: Kuween is the boss of the SMILE Factory on Dressrosa.

154266.name: Scotch
154266.about: "Iron Boy" Scotch is a pirate working under the Yonko Kaido as the guardian of one of his favorite New World islands. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

154433.name: Suleiman
154433.about: Suleiman the Beheader is a war criminal who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi. He eventually joined the Beautiful Pirates, serving under Cavendish. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

154434.name: Mummy
154434.about: Mummy is a sorcerer who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

154435.name: Meadows
154435.about: Meadows participated in a competition at the Corrida Colosseum as a gladiator to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

154436.name: Damask
154436.about: Damask is a pyromaniac who joined as a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum to compete for the Mera Mera no Mi.

154437.name: Acilia
154437.about: Acilia is a gladiator at the Corrida Colosseum who participated in a tournament for the Mera Mera no Mi.

154576.name: Karatachi, Kagura
154576.about: Kagura, is a shinobi of Kirigakure, who works as the Sixth Mizukage's aid. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

154580.name: Onomichi, Hassaku
154580.about: Hassaku is a shinobi of Kirigakure. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

154582.name: Hoshigaki, Shizuma
154582.about: Shisuma, is a shinobi of Kirigakure's Hoshigaki Clan. (Source: Naruto Wikia)

154825.name: Iwne
154825.about: Iwne is the God of Destruction of Universe 1. He is accompanied by his attendant and martial arts teacher Awamo. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

154826.name: Arack
154826.about: Arack is the God of Destruction of Universe 5. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga.

154827.name: Liquiir
154827.about: Liquiir is the God of Destruction of Universe 8. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

154828.name: Sidra
154828.about: Sidra is the God of Destruction of Universe 9.

154829.name: Rumsshi
154829.about: Rumsshi is the God of Destruction of Universe 10. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

154830.name: Geene
154830.about: Geene is the God of Destruction of Universe 12. He appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

154832.name: Martinu
154832.about: Martinu is the Angel of Universe 12 is the attendant and martial arts teacher of Geene. She is also one of the Great Priest's daughters. She appears in Dragon Ball Super during the Universe Survival Saga. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

154833.name: Mosco

156175.name: Morgans
156175.about: "Big News" Morgans is the president of the World Economic Journal and one of the emperors of the Underworld. Morgans gets excited by major events, looking forward to reporting them as news to the world. He tends to exclaim "Big News!" when witnessing a newsworthy event. In fact, whenever a big scoop would pop up, he would retain his calm and composure just to get it, despite the chaos and danger the opportunity presents. He is shown to take pride in being called a newsman and does not tolerate being called otherwise. He is even willing to risk his life on occasion just to take pictures of a newsworthy event. 168014.about: Biscuit summons a masseuse she calls Cookie (クッキィちゃん, Kukkyi-chan) which uses different massaging techniques and a Nen-transmuted lotion to relieve fatigue and restore vitality to anyone it massages. It can also burn off excess fat and cure arthritis, muscle tension and locked joints. It is particularly useful for training/recovery purposes and to treat aging ailments. 168149.name: Akkun
168149.about: Akkun was unique among the Akuta. It has very little aggressive tendencies. More akin to a child, it was shown to be playful and curious at the world around it. It had also shown a strong attachment to Inojin Yamanaka, possibly imprinting on him as a surrogate parent, as it liked to remain around Inojin as much as possible. It however was nervous at meeting other beings and was prone to lash out. Akkun was shown to have a measure of sentient intelligence, as it was very particular on how it was referred to and was capable of talking and learning names, provided they aren't too difficult. Its childishness aside, Akkun was very brave and loyal, as its first instinct was to protect Inojin even against much stronger foes. (Source: Narutopedia)

170671.name: Vegetto
170671.about: Vegetto, or Vegito as per the FUNimation dub, is a Saiyan, who is the result of Son Gokū and Vegeta using Potara earrings to fuse into a singular being. Because he was created from them, his personality has traits of both Vegeta and Gokū and has also inherited their memories. Despite being a fusion of both Gokū and Vegeta, Vegetto's personality appears to garner more of its strengths from the Vegeta-half. He has shown himself to be rude and arrogant in combat, proud of his power and prone to belittling opponents while winning a battle. Vegito wields tremendous power, and he is regarded as one of the mightiest warriors in the entire Dragon Ball franchise. (Source: Dragon Universe Wiki, Dragon Ball Wiki)

184235.about: Loki is a prince of Elbaph, being the son of King Harald and younger half-brother of Hajrudin. Loki refers to himself as the Sun God, a deity worshiped by Elbaph's populace, and claims he will be the one to "end the world". He was once arranged to marry Charlotte Lola, which would have allied Elbaph with the Big Mom Pirates, until Lola ran away. Age: 63 Bounty: 2,600,000,000 (Source: One Piece Wiki)

187859.name: Masked Deuce

Deuce's primary goal is to seek adventure, though he initially did not wish to incriminate himself as a pirate. He appears to act seriously, and was initially off-put by, though eventually gained respect for Ace's cheerful nature. He is reliable and anxious at the same time. He enjoys writing and took the opportunity to write a story of his experiences on Ace's crew. If someone mocks his writing, he will respond by portraying them in a bad light and leaving their names out of the story. (Source: One Piece Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. 191282.name: Namikaze, Menma
191282.about: Appearance in episode 427. Menma Namikaze is a descendant of the Uzumaki clan in Tenten's Infinite Tsukuyomi dream. Menma's life was greatly different than Naruto Uzumaki's, as Menma didn't lose his parents, and had many friends during his childhood. At some point, Kurama was safely transferred from Kushina Uzumaki onto Menma, letting Menma keep his mother while eventually becoming friends with the tailed beast. After graduating from the Academy, Menma became a member of Team Kakashi alongside Sakura Haruno and Sasuke Uchiha. Eventually, Menma became a chūnin. Menma takes more after his father, as opposed to Naruto, who was stated to inherit his mother's personality traits. Menma is calm, collected, talking only when he feels it serves a purpose. In contrast to Naruto, who is usually childish and cheerful, Menma is mature and very serious. He is also shown with a sharp wit, carefully thinking before acting, and able to see the underlying nature of the situation at hand. His insight appears to make him the smartest of his graduating class and also acting as the de facto leader of the group. Much like the real world's Sasuke, Menma is somewhat distant, showing little respect when talking to others, even his parents. He also shows no interest in women despite both Sakura and Hinata fighting over his love, simply telling them to leave him alone. Despite his seriousness, Menma is very loyal to his friends, as he claimed that Tenten's problems were bothering him and wanted to help,

201310.name: Daemon
201310.about: Daemon is a very energetic and mischievous child. He enjoys playing with others and can quickly grow attached to certain people. At the same time, he is fiercely protective of his sister, not letting anyone with less than sincere goals about her near and is determined to protect her from anything he deems a threat to her well-being. Likewise, he is very loyal to her orders, willing to keep quiet about things he would like to tell otherwise. (Source: Narutopedia)

201426.name: Raoul
201426.about: Raoul is an anime-only character. He owns a bar at Loguetown called Gold Roger. In his youth, he used to know Gol D. Roger, who visited his bar and told him he would conquer the Grand Line. Gol D. Roger and his crew once visited Raoul's bar before venturing to the Grand Line. Raoul tried to warn Roger about the dangers of the Grand Line, but Roger was more excited than deterred. When Smoker was in charge of the Marines stationed in Loguetown, no pirates visited Raoul's bar and Smoker became his only customer. When Luffy came to the bar by coincidence, Raoul told him about Roger's exploits. He was deeply shocked at hearing Luffy saying he will be the next Pirate King and noted that the young boy was similar to Roger in his presence. After Luffy left, Smoker visited the bar for a drink. Raoul was not pleased with Smoker's presence. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

203021.name: Kawanami, Kaito
203021.about: Kaito Kawanami is a genin of Konohagakure. Kaito and his team graduated a year before Boruto's class in the Academy. Since then, his team would regularly take missions overseas. (Source: Narutopedia)

203101.name: Small Bear
203101.about: Small Bear is Chimera Ant Squadron Leader. He is one of the few Chimera Ants who stuck around the nest after the King was born.

204898.name: Oyashiro, En

205657.name: Zald
205657.about: Salt is one of the Demons from the Makyo Star who serves under Garlic Jr. along with the other members of the Spice Boys. He assists Garlic Jr. in defeating Kami on the Lookout and later heads to Kame House with the others in an attempt to kidnap Gohan on Garlic Jr.'s orders. When Piccolo intervenes Salt fights with the others. Later on, Salt and Mustard fight Gohan and Krillin atop the Lookout. He fights against Gohan and almost wins. When Salt fires several Surprise Blasts at the young Saiyan, Krillin jumps in the way and takes damage instead. Overcome with anger at the pain of his friend, Gohan kills Salt with a Masenko. (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

205658.name: Snake Way Guide
205658.about: When King Yemma agrees to send Goku on Snake Way, he provides him with a guide who takes him to the start of the road with his Messerschmitt KR. The guide seems to be more intelligent and knowledgeable than most of the other Ogres, wears glasses and has two horns instead of one. His exact function in Other World is unknown, but later (in episode "Day 1") he meets Fortuneteller Baba and gives her Goku's message for Master Roshi (which reaches him via Kami and Yajirobe). (Source: Dragon Ball Wiki)

Having lived for over four centuries, the snake was once the companion of Kalgara and Mont Blanc Noland back when Upper Yard was still part of Jaya. It is the grandchild of the snake Kashigami, whom the Shandia once worshiped as a god. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

208066.name: Fuza
208066.about: Fuza is the name of the giant Sanjocho (三丈鳥, literally meaning "Three Length Bird") of the Skypiean Priest, Shura, who rode on it to get around to the different places at Skypiea. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

She was left on the island of Elegia with Gordon, who became her foster parent and supported her dream of starting a "New Era" and later her desire to achieve this dream through a broadcasted, world-wide concert held on Elegia. Uta's singing voice has been appraised as "otherwordly", enough to grant her the title of the world's greatest diva. (Source: One Piece Wiki)
