222438.name: Megalo
222438.about: Megalo is a shark that lives on Fish-Man Island. He is the beloved pet of Princess Shirahoshi and former pet of the Neptune Army.

222439.name: Oide
222439.about: Oide is a little girl who lives in Sphinx. She is the owner of Tama.

224366.name: Kokushi
224366.about: Kokushi is a villager who joined Boro's cult.

224367.name: Kokatsu
224367.about: Kokatsu is a former shinobi and the biological father to Kawaki.

224485.name: Kurozumi, Higurashi
224485.about: Kurozumi Higurashi was a member of the Kurozumi Family and a major supporter of Kurozumi Orochi.

224815.name: Shimotsuki, Ushimaru
224815.about: Debut: Chapter 953, Episode 954. Occupations: Daimyo of Ringo, Samurai. Shimotsuki Ushimaru was a member of the Shimotsuki Family, and the last daimyo of Ringo in Wano Country. He ruled until the takeover of Kurozumi Orochi as shogun 20 years ago. He was a direct descendant of the legendary samurai Shimotsuki Ryuma. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

225101.name: Saturn, Jaygarcia
225101.about: Member of the Five Elders, who are the heads of the World Government.

226839.name: York
226839.about: York, also designated as Punk-06 (パンク シックス), is one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "greed". (Source: One Piece Wiki)

227696.name: Spiel
227696.about: Spiel the Hexagon is a pirate and the main antagonist of Romance Dawn, Version 2.

227807.name: Kagetsu, Futa
227807.about: Fūta Kagetsu is a medicinal herb salesman and the eldest son of Tōbei Kagetsu who was supposed to inherit his father's money after his apparent death. (Source: Narutopedia)

227808.name: Kagetsu, Toubei
227808.about: Toubei Kagetsu is a medicinal herb salesman from Motoyoshi Village who faked his own death.

227809.name: Kagetsu, Tsukiko
227809.about: Tsukiko Kagetsu is the daughter of Toubei Kagetsu.

227810.name: Kagetsu, Mai
227810.about: Mai Kagetsu is an medicinal herb saleswoman and the youngest daughter of Toubei Kagetsu.

227811.name: Kikunojou
227811.about: Kikunojou was a skilled ninja from the Land of Vegetables.

227812.name: Sanjurou, Shura
227812.about: Shura was the acting leader of the criminal group Shinobazu.

227898.name: Yurinojou
227898.about: Yurinojou is a ninja from the Land of Vegetables.

227899.name: Hanzaki
227899.about: Hanzaki is the leader of the Fuuma clan.

227900.name: Houki
227900.about: Houki was a shinobi from the Takumi Village and the leader of the Four Celestial Symbols Men.

227953.name: Adams
227953.about: Adams is a tertiary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. Adams is a former human and villager from Windknight's Lot who becomes a Zombie created by Dio Brando. Pretending to still be human, he attempts to ambush Poco from behind with his long, stretchable tongue, but is promptly defeated by Jonathan Joestar. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

227954.name: Doobie
227954.about: Doobie is a tertiary antagonist featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. Doobie is a monstrous Zombie created by Dio Brando, with several venomous snakes emerging out of his head. He briefly fights Jonathan Joestar after attempting to eat Poco's sister. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

228316.name: Father Styx
228316.about: Father Styx is a tertiary character featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. Styx is an alcoholic priest who boards a voyage to Mexico for a mission. While on the ship, he discovers Dio Brando's coffin. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

228427.name: Aburame, Harika
228427.about: Harika Aburame is an Academy student from the Aburame clan in Konohagakure. She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. (Source: Narutopedia)

228428.name: Amino, Sousha
228428.about: Sousha Amino is an Academy student of Konohagakure. She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. Sousha writes for the Academy paper. Likewise, she apparently is highly skilled in intelligence-gathering, shown from her in-depth knowledge of various clans and recent events. (Source: Narutopedia)

228429.name: Ganryuu, Doseki
228429.about: Doseki Ganryuu is an Academy student of Konohagakure. He is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. (Source: Narutopedia)

228430.name: Inabikari, Kande
228430.about: Kande Inabikari is an Academy student of Konohagakure. He is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. (Source: Narutopedia)

228431.name: Inuzuka, Mimi
228431.about: Mimi Inuzuka is an Academy student and a member of the Inuzuka clan of Konohagakure. She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. (Source: Narutopedia)

228432.name: Kageno, Kura
228432.about: Kura Kageno is an Academy student of Konohagakure. She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. Kura is a modest girl, who in most cases stands aside, or, being in the company, silently watches what is happening. However, she is no stranger to the interest, and listens to gossip about her classmates with pleasure. She also enjoys horror movies, readily volunteering to join in investigating the spooky Seven Mysteries of the Academy, but still, even after passing part of the tests, she eventually chickened out and ran away. (Source: Narutopedia)

228433.name: Kaka, Hana
228433.about: Hana Kaka is a former assassin from the Land of Bamboo, working undercover as an Academy teacher in Konohagakure. Following her experiences in the village, she relinquished her ties to the Land of Bamboo to truly live as a teacher in Konohagakure. (Source: Narutopedia)

228434.name: Kuromori, Batora
228434.about: Batora Kuromori is a former shinobi and the butler of Kae Yukiwari from the Land of Bamboo. (Source: Narutopedia)

228444.name: Nerikiri, Konashi
228444.about: Konashi Nerikiri is an Academy student of Konohagakure. He is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. (Source: Narutopedia)

228445.name: Sougi, Ran
228445.about: Ran Sougi is an Academy student of Konohagakure. He is the twin brother of Suzu. He is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate (Source: Narutopedia)

228446.name: Sougi, Suzu
228446.about: Suzu Sougi is an Academy student of Konohagakure. She is the twin sister of Ran. She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate (Source: Narutopedia)

228447.name: Tao, Soul
228447.about: Soul Tao is an Academy student of Konohagakure.She is also Himawari Uzumaki's classmate. Soul is a rather energetic girl who tries to follow everything that happens in the life of the class. She has an incredible admiration for Might Guy, keeping his picture in her locket. (Source: Narutopedia)

228448.name: Kamakura, Hibari
228448.about: Hibari Kamakura is an actress in Konohagakure and Osuka's mother. (Source: Narutopedia)

228449.name: Neon's Mother
228449.about: She is the mother of Neon Asakusa and an executive member of the Kaminarimon Company. (Source: Narutopedia)

228451.name: Oppo
228451.about: Oppo is an underling of Aniki. (Source: Narutopedia)

228452.name: Teru
228452.about: Teru is an underling of Aniki. (Source: Narutopedia)

228475.name: Poco's Sister
228475.about: Poco's Sister is an unnamed tertiary ally featured in the first part of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure, Phantom Blood. As the older sister of Poco, she encourages her younger brother to grow stronger and stand up for himself. After being kidnapped by Dio Brando, she courageously declines the vampire's offer to join him. Instead, she joins the group once Jonathan Joestar protects her from the monstrous Doobie. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

228476.name: Tattoo
228476.about: Tattoo, as referred to by Speedwagon, is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. As a resident of Ogre Street, he initially tries to rob Jonathan Joestar alongside Speedwagon and a Kempo Fighter. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

228477.name: Kempo Fighter
228477.about: The unnamed Kempo Fighter is a tertiary ally featured in the first part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Phantom Blood. He originally tries to rob Jonathan Joestar in Ogre Street alongside Robert E. O. Speedwagon and Tattoo. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

228731.name: Maruta
228731.about: Maruta is a hawk trainer that lives in the mountains. He is also the caretaker to the famous Senri Hawk. (Source: Narutopedia)

228732.name: Shitakiri, Mozu
228732.about: Mozu Shitakiri is the owner of Paradise. She shown to be a very methodical businesswoman, having made a fortune in her efforts. (Source: Narutopedia)

228733.name: Shitakiri, Tsuzura
228733.about: Tsuzura Shitakiri is an apprentice caretaker to the famed Senri Hawks. In his love for animals, Tsuzura is talented in caring for them. He is also a quick learner, having started learning better breeding methods from books and likewise begun learning to read. (Source: Narutopedia)

228734.name: Anaguma
228734.about: Anaguma is a shinobi of Kirigakure who also works as a bounty hunter. As a bounty hunter, Anaguma is implied to be highly skilled, especially as he captured a highly wanted and dangerous man in Rokuro. He is able to use Water Release to create water threads, with which he could steady unstable structures. (Source: Narutopedia)

228735.name: Batta
228735.about: Batta is a kunoichi from Kumogakure. She was born on a small island whose inhabitants were displaced after it was bought by rich resort developers. Batta is proficient in using Wind Release, allowing her to conjure a powerful gust of wind in the surrounding area, and boosting herself or others to higher altitudes. She was also able to find structural weak points by placing her hands on and sending her chakra through it. (Source: Narutopedia)

228736.name: Fugou
228736.about: Fugou is a businessman. He is among a group of Thunder Train passengers taken to Ouga's labyrinth in order for him to run his survival experiments. (Source: Narutopedia)

228737.name: Gankubi, Kiseru
228737.about: Kiseru Gankubi is an Anbu from Konohagakure. He is a former undercover agent as an Outer of Kara. As an Anbu, Kiseru is a highly capable ninja. Even when outnumbered by other competent shinobi, he is able to overwhelm his opponents. (Source: Narutopedia)

228738.name: Namua
228738.about: Namua is a former shinobi and competent taijutsu user. He is shown to be quite strong, able to hold back a crushing ceiling for a period of time, and survive Rokuro's double slash to his back after breaking free of his control. (Source: Narutopedia)

228739.name: Ouga
228739.about: Ouga is a former Inner from the organisation Kara. As a former Inner of Kara whose body was modified with Scientific Ninja Tools by Amado, Ouga was regarded as being completely monstrous in terms of power and ability. However, only her brain was augmented and she doesn't consider herself suited for combat. Disguised as "Yatsume", she joined the Thunder Train with several passengers. Dropping the Yatsume facade, she revealed herself as the true Ouga, explaining who she was and what she wanted. Due to her brain damage which left her without a desire for survival, she wanted Boruto to break the genjutsu and free everyone, but as the construct collapsed around them, Boruto refused to give up on her. Reaching out to Boruto when he reached out to save her was enough to cause her to leave the genjutsu herself, where she proceeded to free everyone. She left before everyone came to and left Shamo a letter addressed to Boruto, which he delivered. In it, she teased him about trying to guess the dream that sparked in her and promised to visit him one day. (Source: Narutopedia)

228741.name: Rokuro
228741.about: Rokuro is a missing-nin. He defected his village and had a bounty on him, leading to his capture by Anaguma and his partner. He also sustained an injury he kept concealed. Back home, he expected to receive at least a life sentence. (Source: Narutopedia)

228742.name: Shamo
228742.about: Shamo is a young shinobi from Iwagakure, can use Earth Release to produce large walls and spikes. He can also creates wave of earth for defensive purposes. (Source: Narutopedia)

228871.name: Fundaru
228871.about: Fundaru is a messenger for the Land of Redaku's Prime Minister. (Source: Narutopedia)

228874.name: Ganno
228874.about: Ganno is a citizen of the Land of Redaku. He is imprisoned at the Astronomy Research Institute. (Source: Narutopedia)

228877.name: Jiji
228877.about: Jiji is a prisoner at the Astronomy Research Institute. He was originally a ninja of Sunagakure. A few years prior to the events of Sasuke Retsuden, the Prime Minister of the Land of Redaku visited the village while he was touring the region. While there, he hired Jiji to come to Redaku and train an army of ninja, as Redaku was historically a peaceful country with no combat experience. Jiji travelled to Redaku's capital city and was given a room in the royal palace; one of the palace maids, Margo was assigned to attend to him. Over time, Jiji and Margo fell in love, with Jiji deciding to abandon the life of a ninja in order to be with her. At the last, Jiji was reunited with Margo in Redaku's capital. A year later, they both accompanied King Nanara to the Astronomy Research Institute, with Jiji providing a tour of the grounds as Nanara contemplated how best to restore the Institute to its former glory. (Source: Narutopedia)

228879.name: Penjira
228879.about: Penjira is a citizen of the Land of Redaku. He is imprisoned at the Astronomy Research Institute. (Source: Narutopedia)

228882.name: Manari
228882.about: Manari is the daughter of the Land of Redaku's previous king. (Source: Narutopedia)

228886.name: Margo
228886.about: Margo is the caretaker of Nanara, the Land of Redaku's prince. She originally lived in Redaku's capital city, working as a maid in the royal palace. She initially lacked any specific role within the palace, instead broadly serving the royal family or their guests as needed. A few years prior to the events of Sasuke Retsuden, Redaku's Prime Minister assigned Margo to be the personal maid of Jiji, a shinobi from Sunagakure temporarily living within the palace. In time, Jiji fell in love with Margo and lost interest in returning to Suna, much less continuing as a shinobi. Following the Prime Minister's defeat, Kakashi sends a letter to Sasuke Uchiha, reporting the outcome of the battle. The letter includes details of Margo's assistance in the victory and that she will accompany Nanara, now Redaku's King, back to the capital city. Sasuke shares this letter with Jiji, revealing to him that Margo is alive and well. A year later, Margo accompanies Nanara to the Astronomy Research Institute; they are guided there by Jiji, who, like Margo, now serves as one of Nanara's aides. Nanara expresses an interest in rebuilding the Institute and perhaps even expanding it beyond what it was prior to its destruction. He asks Margo if she thinks his sister, Manari, would approve of this idea. Margo speculates that Manari would complain about the potential cost, but otherwise would probably go along with it. Nanara is pleased with this answer and has Jiji take them on a tour of the area surrounding

228887.name: Nanara
228887.about: Nanara is the son of the Land of Redaku's previous king. (Source: Narutopedia)

228890.name: Prime Minister
228890.about: The Prime Minister (Saishou) of the Land of Redaku assists the country's monarch. (Source: Narutopedia)

230011.name: Watagash
230011.about: Episodes: 73-74 Dangerous parasitic criminal. He took over the body of Barry Kahn whose mind was filled with rage towards Gohan. He used this rage to turn him into a monster and cause chaos on Earth. No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

230236.name: Zunesha
230236.about: Debut: Chapter 802; Episode 751. Zunesha has the appearance of a large elephant, comparable to an island in sheer scale; its legs are disproportionate and very long, so it can walk on the ocean floor while the rest of its body remains above the water. The legs have two joints. However, he has relatively small eyes that have sunk deep into their sockets, barely visible most of the time and giving the impression that he has no eyes at all. His skin was very wrinkled, reflecting his old age, and his ears were ragged and frayed at the edges. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

230285.name: Guernica
230285.about: Guernica is a member of the intelligence agency CP0.

230344.name: Kuna, Niko
230344.about: Niko Kuna is a veteran researcher who works for the S.R.D.I., which is tied to the 12th Division of the Gotei 13. She is the younger sister of Mashiro Kuna. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

230345.name: Oomaeda, Mareyo
230345.about: Mareyo Oomaeda is the daughter of Marenoshin and sister of Marechiyo Oomaeda. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

231067.name: Marcus, Mars
231067.about: Member of the Five Elders, who are the heads of the World Government.

231069.name: Ethanbaron, V. Nusjuro
231069.about: Member of the Five Elders, who are the heads of the World Government.

231070.name: Shepherd, Ju Peter
231070.about: Member of the Five Elders, who are the heads of the World Government.

231333.name: Koku-Ou
231333.about: King Furry, known as the King in the Japanese version, is an anthropomorphic dog who is the current King of Earth during the Dragon Ball series.

232799.name: Eggplant Soldier
232799.about: Eggplant Soldier is a soldier of the Big Mom Pirates, serving as a guard at the Whole Cake Chateau. He was Sanji's helper during his stay at the castle before his planned wedding to Charlote Pudding. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

233718.name: Mr. 13
233718.about: Mr. 13 is an assassin member of the Baroque Works crime syndicate, responsible for executing Baroque agents who have failed their missions. He is one half of "The Unluckies" team alongside Miss Friday. (Source: One Piece Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

233864.name: Bobomba
233864.about: Bobomba is a dwarf from Tontatta Kingdom who first appeared on Green Bit. He is the younger brother of Bomba. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

234677.name: Izuno, Amagi
234677.about: Amagi Izuno is a kunoichi of Konohagakure, the head of the Izuno Clan, and the Grandmother of Wasabi Izuno.

234678.name: Izuno, Mazuma
234678.about: Mazuma Izuno is a member of Konohagakure's Izuno Clan and the Mother of Wasabi Izuno.

234679.name: Izuno, Daruma
234679.about: Daruma Izuno is a member of Konohagakure's Izuno Clan and is the Father of Wasabi Izuno.

235315.name: Mozuku
235315.about: Mozuku is a boy from the Land of Calm Seas.

236611.name: Juki
236611.about: Juki is a member of the Numbers in the Beasts Pirates and appears in the Wano Country Arc.

237203.name: Funamushi
237203.about: Funamushi is a pirate from the Funato clan.

237204.name: Funato, Seiren
237204.about: Seiren Funato is a pirate from the Funato clan.

237205.name: Funato, Ikada
237205.about: Ikada Funato is a boy from the Land of Water, who was born into the Funato Clan.

237241.name: Funato, Minamo
237241.about: Minamo Funato is a pirate of the Funato Clan, the wife of Araumi Funato, and mother of Isari, Seiren, and Ikada. (Source: Narutopedia)

237242.name: Funato, Isari
237242.about: Isari Funato is a pirate from the Land of Water. (Source: Narutopedia)

237243.name: Funato, Araumi
237243.about: Araumi Funato is a pirate, as well as the head of the Funato Clan. (Source: Narutopedia)

237244.name: Funato, Tenma
237244.about: Tenma Funato is a pirate from the Land of Water. He is also the fleet commander for the Funato Clan's Tenma Unit. (Source: Narutopedia)

240901.name: Lilith
240901.about: Lilith, also designated as Punk-02 (パンク ツー), is one of six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "evil". (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241125.name: Shaka
241125.about: Shaka, also designated as Punk-01 (パンク ワン), was one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "good". (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241364.name: Atlas
241364.about: Atlas, also designated as Punk-05 (パンク ファイブ), is one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "violence". (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241374.name: Edison
241374.about: Edison, also designated as Punk-03 (パンク スリー), is one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "thinking". (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241375.name: Pythagoras
241375.about: Pythagoras, also designated as Punk-04 (パンク フォー), was one of the six satellites of Dr. Vegapunk, embodying his aspect of "wisdom". He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Egghead Arc until his death, caused by one of his creations: S-Snake. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241452.name: Hibari
241452.about: Hibari is a young woman of regular stature. She has light hair with bangs worn in a ponytail. Her Marine uniform consists of a military pocketed shirt that exposes her midriff, gloves, military boots and camo pants, with the latter's right side ripped to reveal striped leggings. She also wears headphones over her ears, a belt with heart-shaped buckles around her torso, and a backpack with a hanging teddy bear called "Kopy-senpai" (コピー先輩). (Source: One Piece Wiki)

241610.name: Doll
241610.about: Doll is a Marine Vice Admiral and Commander of the G-14 Marine Base. Doll is a tall, busty woman with blue eyes, long eyelashes, and short black hair with bangs. She wears a black short-sleeved top with a cleavage and black leather pants with a brown belt and a buckle in the shape of a skull and crossbones. She also wears a spiked choker, hoop earrings, and has small, purple flower tattoos on her arms. Doll is seemingly not an empathetic person, asking Tashigi to quiet down Helmeppo after his friend Koby had been kidnapped. Doll was also annoyed at Garp for borrowing Navy manpower in an operation to rescue Koby from the Blackbeard Pirates without clearance. Doll however does appear to have a soft spot for children, as she agreed with Vegapunk's request to attach balloons to the Marine Headquarters G-14 Branch to make the Punk Hazard children feel more at ease. As a Marine, Doll strongly believes in justice, though whether she believes in Moral Justice or Absolute Justice is still unknown. She is strong enough to damage a Mark III Pacifista with a kick.

242014.name: Prince, Grus
242014.about: Prince Grus is a Marine Rear Admiral stationed at Marine Base G-14 and a member of SWORD. His fellow SWORD members also refer to Grus by the title of Prince (王子, Ouji) which differs from his surname. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

242972.name: Sengi Guild Agent
242972.about: The Sengi Guild Agent is an employment agent working in the underground Sengi Guild which hires new and old Hunters for various jobs. (Source: Hunterpedia)

243327.name: Tararan
243327.about: Tararan was a General Zombie and the Commander of the Spider Mice on Thriller Bark. He was the one that had caught the Thousand Sunny in his webs, forcing the Straw Hat Pirates to enter the island. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

243328.name: Kaba Shinshi
243328.about: Hippo Gentleman was a Wild Zombie who worked under Perona. He was the vice commander of the Wild Zombies.

243855.name: Tamagon
243855.about: Tamagon is a member of the Franky Family.

243856.name: Honner
243856.about: Dr. Honner was the doctor aboard Mont Blanc Noland's expedition fleet 400 years ago.

243857.name: Koala Zombie
243857.about: Koala Zombie is a wild zombie who works under Perona's command.

245051.name: Wagarashi, Kyuuroku
245051.about: Kyuuroku Wagarashi is the head of the Wagarashi family in the Land of Tea, which is a clan warring with the nearby Wasabi family. (Source: Narutopedia)

245286.name: Torue
245286.about: Torue is a member of the Shinigami Research and Development Institute who is specialized in capturing people. Torue is a curvaceous woman who wears the standard uniform of the S.R.D.I.. She has long, purple hair, green eyes and large lips with pale skin. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

245295.name: Kobuna
245295.about: Kobuna is a pirate of the Funato Clan, and son of Funamushi.

245303.name: Ginny
245303.about: The former East Army commander of the Revolutionary Army, having joined the group alongside Bartholomew Kuma, back when they were known as the Freedom Fighters. She was the mother of Jewelry Bonney. She was previously a slave who was forced to take part in the Native Hunting Competition on God Valley 38 years ago. She and Emporio Ivankov were responsible for orchestrating the God Valley Incident as a means of escaping the Native Hunting Competition. She was captured by the World Government and became the eighth wife to a World Noble. She was also one of Jaygarcia Saturn's test subjects and developed the Sapphire Scales disease after a failed experiment. Ginny was then released from slavery and used the little time remaining to her to return to the Sorbet Kingdom with her child, dying as a result. After her death, she was succeeded by Belo Betty.

246037.name: Unabara, Awaji
246037.about: Awaji Unabara is the son of the Land of Water daimyou.

246038.name: Funato, Jibiki
246038.about: Jibiki Funato is a pirate from the Funato Clan, working for Isari Funato.

246114.name: Hibiki
246114.about: Hibiki is the sister of Kodama.

246115.name: Kodama
246115.about: Kodama is the brother of Hibiki.

246967.name: Obuta
246967.about: Obuta is the leader of a youth gang that has a score to settle with Ichigo Kurosaki. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

247225.name: S-Snake
247225.about: S-Snake is one of the Seraphim and a clone of Boa Hancock.

247235.name: S-Hawk
247235.about: S-Hawk is one of the Seraphim and a clone of Dracule Mihawk.

247236.name: S-Bear
247236.about: S-Bear is one of the Seraphim and a clone of Bartholomew Kuma.

247237.name: S-Shark
247237.about: S-Shark is one of the Seraphim and a clone of Jinbe.

247238.name: Hound
247238.about: Hound is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. He is a tall man with messy hair and square jaw and wears glasses with pointed ends and lipstick. He also wears a pinstripe double-breast suit with a dark suit and tie underneath it and a pair of black gloves. As a high-ranking officer he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247239.name: Guillotine
247239.about: Guillotine is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. He is a tall man with dark hair with a white stripe on the right side of his head and also with a long dark beard with the end being curly, reaching done to his abdomen, with a white line on the right side of the beard. He wears sunglasses and a crescent-shaped blade on top of his head. He also wears a light double-breast suit with his long sleeves rolled up and a dark suit and a tie underneath it. As a high ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247240.name: Red King
247240.about: Red King is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. He is a large, bald man. He has a large mouth and a long neck with six chins and the word "MARINE" tattooed on the side. He wears a pinstripe suit with a dark shirt and light tie underneath and the Justice coat draped over his shoulders. He also wears a giant gauntlet on his right arm with the word "RED" written on it. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247241.name: Tosa
247241.about: Tosa is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. He is a big burly man with a big roundish beard. He has huge hairy muscular arms and big hands. He wears a cap with the word "MARINES" on, as well a dark t-shirt, light pants, dark boots. As a high-ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247242.name: Pomsky
247242.about: Pomsky is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. He is a burly man, donning a dark double-breasted suit, a Marine coat draped over his shoulders, black sunglasses, and a Marine cap. He has wavy light hair, a handlebar mustache, a scar on his left cheek, and a cleft chin. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247243.name: Bluegrass
247243.about: Bluegrass is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the siege of Egghead. She is a short, old woman with a large amount of wrinkles and light hair arranged in a bowl cut and pigtails. She wears flowery pants, a tie, sunglasses and a pair of headphones. Like many Marines, she wears her sailing coat draped over her shoulders. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247244.name: Urban
247244.about: Urban is a Marine Vice Admiral and one of the nine that took part in the Egghead Incident. Urban is a tall man with a monster-like face with his sharp teeth and pointed fangs similar to Ancient Giants, and also have long flowing hair reaching done to his waist. He wears a top with the word "MARINE" on with two lines in it, and he also wears a double-breast suit with a dark suit and tie underneath it. As a high-ranking officer, he wears a Justice coat draped over his shoulders. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

247245.name: Kujaku
247245.about: Kujaku is a Marine Rear Admiral stationed at Marine Base G-14 and also a member of SWORD. She is the granddaughter of Marine Vice Admiral Tsuru. Kujaku is a domineering woman who often employs flirtatious, yet abusive language, not shying away to use it on her fellow co-Marines or even superiors. She is a shapely young woman with long strawberry blonde hair, green eyes, prominent lips and large breasts. She wears a strapless pink dress with red blotch-like patterns on it, a Marine coat draped over her shoulders and a pink cloche hat decorated with a seagull-flower accessory on the left side and an "M" on the front. As a Marine rear admiral, Kujaku has authority over lower-ranking subordinates. She is also part of the Marine squadron SWORD, meaning she has the freedom to disregard orders from her superiors and move and act as she pleases. Kujaku ate the Muchi Muchi no Mi, a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows her to use whips to command anything she lashes, including objects. (Source: One Piece Wiki, edited)

248144.name: Seike, Nobutsune
248144.about: Nobutsune Seike, also known as The Butler of the Kuchiki House, is the chief retainer of the Kuchiki Clan. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

248493.name: Figarland, Garling
248493.about: Saint Figarland Garling is a World Noble of the Figarland Family and the Supreme Commander of the God's Knights, of whom he is the first to be introduced. He was formerly active as a "Champion" on God Valley. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

251508.name: Rokusuke
251508.about: Rokusuke is a miner from the Land of Rivers. Rokusuke has short black hair and black eyes. He wears a grey bandanna tied backwards, and a blue yukata. (Source: Narutopedia)

251515.name: Sangorou
251515.about: Sangorou is a miner from the Land of Rivers. Sangorou has a short crop of black hair and thick eyebrows. He has a very short beard that is gray in color. This beard is very close to his skin. He also wears a bandanna on his head covering his hair and it is tied in the back. (Source: Narutopedia)

251571.name: Sukeza
251571.about: Sukeza is a miner from Katabami Gold Mine. Sukeza lived in fear of Raiga and his men. He hated being helped by anyone because of what Raiga would do to him. He was so afraid of them that he would go as far as to beat himself up to make it look like he was attacked. (Source: Narutopedia)

251864.name: Gosunkugi
251864.about: Gosunkugi is a thief who operates in and out of the Land of Stone. On one occasion, he murdered a family of three and left the blame on another man that he briefly fought upon departure. That man was the local blacksmith Tokichi (who became Sazanami) who fled from the vengeful villagers and became a bounty hunter to hunt down Gosunkugi. Over the years he has accumulated a bounty of three million ryou. (Source: Narutopedia)

251865.name: Manaka, Michizou
251865.about: Michizou Manaka is a bandit from the Land of Stone. He is easily offended, as seen when Sazanami gives Akamaru some milk, on Michizou's bill. He also sees no problem in stealing money from children. (Source: Narutopedia)

252458.name: Alpha
252458.about: Alpha is a member of the CP8 branch of Cipher Pol. She is the younger sister of CP0 agent Kalifa and the youngest daughter of Laskey. Posing as a nurse, she was responsible for overseeing and secretly keeping the young Jewelry Bonney as a hostage following the brokering of a deal between Bartholomew Kuma and the World Government to create the Pacifistas in exchange for performing life-saving treatment to cure Bonney's Sapphire Scales affliction. She is a slim, curvaceous woman with long light-colored hair and sporting glasses and lipstick. She wears a typical nurse outfit with high stockings. Overall, she greatly resembles Kalifa. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

252501.name: Potcha
252501.about: Potcha and his partner Mondai were two imposters who tried infiltrating Konohagakure. Potcha and Mondai sought fame in their village and apparently spent months perfecting their "disguise" technique. Potcha appears to be goofy and not very smart, very much like his partner Mondai. Potcha along with Mondai put on football helmets and charge at the enemy with a high-speed attack though it is unknown what the effects of this technique are since it was halted. (Source: Narutopedia)

252721.name: Oowashi
252721.about: Oowashi was the daimyou of the Land of Birds. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

252722.name: Amachi
252722.about: Amachi is a medical-nin and scientist who was an accomplice of Orochimaru. (Source: Narutopedia)

252723.name: Hitode
252723.about: Hitode is in charge of protecting the shipments of gold that the Land of the Sea sends to Kirigakure as payment to protect its many islands. (Source: Narutopedia)

252724.name: Kaisen, Agari
252724.about: Agari Kaisen is the head of the Kedouin Clan and is an old friend of Tsunade. (Source: Narutopedia)

252725.name: Hotarubi
252725.about: Hotarubi was a jounin from Hoshigakure. (Source: Narutopedia)

252726.name: Shisou
252726.about: Shisou is a Hoshigakure shinobi who worked under Akahoshi. (Source: Narutopedia)

252729.name: Kagetsu, Kiyoyasu
252729.about: Kiyoyasu Kagetsu is a citizen from the Land of Fire and a member of the Kagetsu Family. (Source: Narutopedia)

252730.name: Jiga
252730.about: Jiga was the second oldest brother from the Janin trio. (Source: Narutopedia)

252731.name: Chikara
252731.about: Chikara is the current daimyou of the Land of Noodles. (Source: Narutopedia)

252732.name: Fuku
252732.about: Fuku is the daughter of a rich daimyou. She later got engaged to the daimyou of the Land of Noodles, Chikara. (Source: Narutopedia)

252733.name: Kayo
252733.about: Kayo is the wife of the daimyou of the Land of Honey. She originated from the Land of Bean Jam. (Source: Narutopedia)

252734.name: Kubisaki, Kouza
252734.about: Kouza Kubisaki was the leader of the Land of Neck. (Source: Narutopedia)

252737.name: Ryuudouin, Genshou
252737.about: Genshou Ryuudouin is a taijutsu master and one of the Three Ryuudouin Brothers, alongside Jakou and Rokkaku, who were seeking revenge against Might Guy for their father's humiliation and death. (Source: Narutopedia)

252738.name: Yagura
252738.about: Yagura was a genin from Konohagakure that Might Guy was going to train. (Source: Narutopedia)

252741.name: Ryuudouin, Agira
252741.about: Agira Ryuudouin was the father of Jakou, Rokkaku and Genshou. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

252742.name: Ryuudouin, Jakou
252742.about: Jakou Ryuudouin is one of the Three Ryuudouin Brothers, alongside Rokkaku and Genshou, who were seeking revenge against Might Guy for their father's humiliation and death. (Source: Narutopedia)

252743.name: Ryuudouin, Rokkaku
252743.about: Rokkaku Ryuudouin is one of the Three Ryuudouin Brothers, alongside Jakou and Genshou, who were seeking revenge against Might Guy for their father's humiliation and death. (Source: Narutopedia)

252779.name: Kanna
252779.about: Kanna is a citizen of Konohagakure as well as the current Master Carpenter. (Source: Narutopedia)

252908.name: Kurama, Uroko
252908.about: Uroko Kurama was a member of the main branch of the Kurama clan. She was also the wife of Murakumo Kurama and the mother of Yakumo Kurama. (Source: Narutopedia)

252909.name: Kurama, Murakumo
252909.about: Murakumo Kurama was a jounin of Konohagakure and head of the main branch of the Kurama clan. (Source: Narutopedia)

252910.name: Monju
252910.about: Monju was a member of the criminal group Shinobazu. (Source: Narutopedia)

252911.name: Toki
252911.about: Toki was a member of Shinobazu. (Source: Narutopedia)

252912.name: Tsuzumi
252912.about: Tsuzumi is a police captain from the Land of Forests. (Source: Narutopedia)

252915.name: Fuki
252915.about: Fuki is a little girl who lives in the Land of Rice Fields. (Source: Narutopedia)

252916.name: Shiin
252916.about: Shiin was the leader of a group of bandits originating from the Land of Rice Fields. (Source: Narutopedia)

252918.name: Suiko
252918.about: Suiko was a shinobi from the Takumi Village and a member of the Four Celestial Symbols Men. (Source: Narutopedia)

252932.name: Howling Gab
252932.about: Debut: Episode 489 "Howling" Gab is one of the Senior Officers of the Red Hair Pirates. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

252940.name: Hongou
252940.about: Hongou is the one of the Senior Officers and the doctor of the Red Hair Pirates.

253126.name: Paramia, Roka
253126.about: Prior to becoming a Números, Roka was a white, spider-like Adjuchas Hollow, born from Szayelaporro Granz' successful attempts to create an artificial Menos. At some point before becoming an Arrancar, around 250 years before, Roka was sent to the Rukongai by Szayelaporro alongside several weaker Hollows so he could observe the Shinigami in combat. In the Arrancar arc, doing her duties as a nurse in Las Noches, Roka reattaches Yammy Llargo's severed arm. Trivia: This character is not named by Tite Kubo in the manga or databooks, nor is she named in the anime. The name Roka Paramia comes from the novel Bleach: Spirits Are Forever With You by Ryougo Narita. (Source: Bleach Wiki)

253415.name: Kirisaki
253415.about: Kirisaki is a missing-nin from Kirigakure.

255312.name: Mozuku
255312.about: Mozuku is a chunin from Konohagakure. Mozuku has dark coloured hair that is concealed by his forehead protector which he wears like a bandanna. He also wears glasses and the standard outfit of the Torture and Interrogation Force which consists of a grey suit with pockets and lapels. Not much has been seen in the way of Mozuku's abilities but he is skilled enough to aid Inoichi in delving into the minds of the enemy in order to retrieve potentially valuable information. (Source: Narutopedia)

255400.name: Hera
255400.about: Hera is a thundercloud homie created by Big Mom at Wano Country as a replacement for Zeus. She is a special kind of homie, having received a soul fragment from Big Mom herself, and serves as one of her personal weapons alongside Prometheus and Napoleon. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

256932.name: Madam Shijimi
256932.about: Madam Shijimi is the wife of the daimyou of the Land of Fire. Team Kakashi in Part I and Team Ebisu in Part II are assigned to find her lost cat, Tora, soon after becoming genin. She has been described as spendthrift, vain, and philanthropistic. She also loves her cat a lot, although the cat clearly does not share the same degree of affection to her. Madam Shijimi is a corpulent woman with dark brown hair that she keeps in three separate poofs. She wears pink lipstick, pink nail-polish and purple eyeshadow. She also wears many different colored rings. (Source: Narutopedia)

256933.name: Sajou
256933.about: Sajou is a Senior from Sunagakure. Normally squinting, Sajou has shoulder-length dark hair which is concealed underneath a ghutrah and wears the standard attire of the Sunagakure Seniors. As a member of the advisory council, he is most likely one of Sunagakure's wisest shinobi. (Source: Narutopedia)

257442.name: Alice
257442.about: Alice is a 10 year old girl who works as Iceberg's secretary.

265351.name: Manmayer, Gunko
265351.about: Gunko is a young woman of average height. She has light hair and appears to have heterochromia, with a dark right eye, and a light left one.

266599.name: Anjo
266599.about: Anjo is a pirate admirer. He witnessed Gol D. Roger's execution. He has a tattoo of a plain Jolly Roger on his right arm. No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

266601.name: Lord of the Coast
266601.about: The Lord of the Coast is a Sea King that inhabits the waters of Dawn Island, typically near Foosha Village. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

266606.name: Pandawomanmi
266606.about: Pandawomanmi is the female version of Pandaman. She first appeared in the Amazon Lily Arc where Pandaman would not be allowed (as men are forbidden on Amazon Lily). (Source: One Piece Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

266621.name: Bellett
266621.about: Bellett was the prince of an unnamed kingdom who became a pirate and was consequently imprisoned in Impel Down, and whose gender was unwillingly inverted. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

266712.name: Sam
266712.about: Sam-san is a drunk man from Cocoyasi Village. On many occasions, he wanders around unknowingly when he is drunk. (Source: One Piece Wikia)

266714.name: Motzel
266714.about: Mr. Motzel is a gourmand and one of the known customers of the Baratie. (Source: One Piece Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

266716.name: Buggy Pirate (Victim)
266716.about: The pirate who initially reports Nami's theft of the Grand Line map. In the anime, instead of being executed, is spared after sufficient begging. (Source: One Piece Wiki) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

266717.name: Buggy Ball Attendant
266717.about: The small, thick-lipped, party hat-wearing pirate who brings Nami's join-offer to Buggy (and later reports that Nami has also stolen the key to Luffy's cage). In the anime, he's shown performing other duties, such as loading Buggy Balls into the crew's cannons. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

266770.about: Debut: Episode 31 An Arlong pirate who pursued Usopp when he arrived in the village of Gosa. He's a fishman who looks like a monkfish.

266773.name: Black Cat Pirate (Hammer)
266773.about: Debut: Episode 12 A Black Cat pirate who hit Usopp on the head during the pirate invasion of the village of Sirop. He's the only member of the crew to fight with a hammer.

266775.name: Alvida Pirate (S Tattoo)
266775.about: Debut: Episode 1 A pirate from Alvida's crew whose distinctive feature is an S-shaped tattoo on his face. Absent from the manga, he replaces Heppoko in his scene with Luffy. (Source : One Piece Wiki)

266796.name: Colon
266796.about: Colon is a giant child living on the island of Elbaf, the land of giants. He is the half-human half-giant son of Scopper Gaban and Ripley. Despite his appearance, he is actually 20 years old, but is physically 6-7 years old as giants grow three times slower than humans. Colon holds admiration for strong pirates, including Shanks, the Giant Warrior Pirates, and Luffy. He is known as a delinquent among the other giant schoolchildren, and appears quite violent compared to their more recent peaceful upbringing. He requested to join the red-haired pirates when they were staying on Elbaf, but was turned down by their captain, Shanks. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

266936.name: Alvida Pirate (Horned)
266936.about: Debut: Episode 1 A pirate from Alvida's crew wearing a helmet with horns. He overhears Nami as she prepares to steal their treasure. But she quickly defeats him.

They were four men who drank the Hero Water and attempted to take down Crocodile, but failed and died from the water's side effects shortly after Crocodile refused to even fight them to give them an honorable death. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

He also wears an apron, and on the back of it has the words "当番", meaning "on duty". He mistook Nami for a cleaning girl when she changed into a apron to trick the Marines. He was first shown showing Vice Admiral Jonathan the books on the Going Merry. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

However, they were also worried for him when they heard that the Straw Hat Pirates were about to get caught in the "fangs of Navarone". With his help, the cooks were able to convince Jessica to use Sanji's curry recipe. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

268522.name: King (500 Hostages)
268522.about: Debut: Episode 305 15 years ago a kingdom was invaded by pirates, where 500 of its soldiers were taken hostage, and the captain demanded to be named the new king of the kingdom. The desperate king was about to accept the request. However, one of his subjects tells him that a government emissary has arrived. Here appears a 13-year-old Rob Lucci, which angers the king by believing that the World Government was mocking them by sending a child. Lucci approached the king, who asked him to save the soldiers, but the boy told the king not to question the ways of the World Government. This left the king very confused about him, since despite being a child, he was terrified of him. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

269130.name: Minatomo (East Blue)
269130.about: Debut: Episode 55 Minatomo-san is a traveling carpenter (in)famously obsessed with repairing any broken door he sees. A native of Wano Country, he left with Shimotsuki Kouzaburou and Furiko 55 years ago and resettled in the East Blue. One of his relatives, also known as Minatomo, remains in Wano. He originated in the SBS as a joke used by Eiichiro Oda to "explain" an art oversight in Chapter 1 (namely, a door at Partys Bar reappearing intact minutes after Higuma kicked off its hinges). Since then, the anime has periodically used him as an Easter Egg (not unlike Pandaman) in crowd shots and the like. Interestingly, he has never appeared in the manga proper, with even an identical carpenter in the Wano Country Arc identified as a separate person. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

270390.name: Pastor Zombie
270390.about: Debut: Episode 353 The pastor zombie is a zombie that serves as the pastor on Thriller Bark. He is a skinny old man that wears a tall hat with a cross on it. He is also dressed in the typical garments for a priest. He was first seen when Absalom carried in an unconscious Nami in to take her measurements for the wedding dress. Later, he is seen at the ceremonial hall in charge of the wedding ceremony, as Absalom and an unconscious Nami exchange their vows. However, before the two can kiss, Sanji shows up and stops the wedding. Throughout Sanji and Absalom's fights, the pastor and a fellow zombie are constantly in surprise at both Sanji and Absalom's pervertedness and the fact that Sanji was able to attack Absalom at ease. Later, in the confusion after Oars destroys the hall, Absalom and the pastor escape to a random room to continue the ceremony. However, Nami suddenly awakes and shocks Absalom unconscious to which the pastor replies by taking note that Absalom had long been weakened after his fight with Sanji. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

270396.name: Tailor Zombie
270396.about: Debut: Episode 352 The tailor zombie is a zombie that serves as the tailor on Thriller Bark. He is a short old man with gray hair and wears a red bowtie. He was also able to remove his eye from its socket. He was first seen when Absalom carried in an unconscious Nami in to take her measurements for the wedding dress. Upon being asked about the wedding preparations, he responded by stating that they were ready as always. In the anime, a scene is added in which he whips the two painting zombies with his tape measure to prevent them from peeping on Nami as he changed her into her wedding dress. He does this as he knows that Absalom was secretly still in the room waiting to see Nami be changed and so warns the paintings that they would be in trouble if they actually saw Nami being changed. (Source: One Piece Wiki)

273165.name: Linlin's Father
273165.about: Debut: Episode 836 When she was a little girl, Linlin innocently looked up to her parents and believed anything they told her. Because of her uncontrollable behavior, her parents were ultimately forced to abandon her because of the many atrocities she caused to her homeland. Her mother cried after leaving her and both parents were hopeful that their daughter could live a better life under Mother Carmel's care. At first, Linlin seemed to be optimistic regarding their departure, believing they would return for her, even after a long period of absence. She eventually gave up and went to the Sheep's House without any signs of sadness nor anger to her now long-gone parents.
