286395.name: Akimichi, Makaro
286395.about: Makaro Akimichi is a chuunin of Konohagakure's Akimichi clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #631 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #372 Makaro is mentioned to have only been promoted to chuunin before the war. Although the full extent of his abilities are unknown, as an Akimichi, Makaro can convert calories into chakra in order to perform his clan's secret techniques. (Source: Narutopedia)

286396.name: Akimichi, Maruten
286396.about: Maruten Akimichi is a tokubetsu jounin of Konohagakure's Akimichi clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #534 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #275 Nature Type: Yang Release In the anime, it was shown that Maruten entered the Academy at the same time as Itachi Uchiha. The two also attended the same class. (Source: Narutopedia)

286397.name: Akimichi, Torifu
286397.about: Torifu Akimichi was a jounin of Konohagakure's Akimichi clan. Along with his teammates, Kagami Uchiha and Danzou Shimura, he was a direct subordinate of the Second Hokage. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #481 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #211 In the anime, shortly after the founding of the village, he was shown to be part of a class alongside Koharu Utatane and Homura Mitokado. Later he watched on as Hiruzen Sarutobi and Danzou Shimura were about to spar, along with Koharu and Kagami Uchiha. (Source: Narutopedia)

286398.name: Akimichi, Shitou
286398.about: Shitou Akimichi is a jounin of Konohagakure's Akimichi clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #422 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #159 Like other members of the Akimichi clan he is very robust, also, like most members of his clan he wears a samurai-like outfit with the kanji for "food" (食, shoku) on the front and has distinctive markings on his cheeks. He wears his short brown hair in a topknot ponytail style. He showed skills in his clan's secret techniques when he used the Partial Multi-Size Technique in his fight against Pain. He was also seen wielding a bō, indicating skills in bukijutsu. (Source: Narutopedia)

286405.name: Aburame, Shikuro
286405.about: Shikuro Aburame was a shinobi from Konohagakure's Aburame clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #475 (Mentioned) Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #208 (Mentioned) (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286414.name: Inuzuka, Gaku
286414.about: Gaku Inuzuka is a jounin from Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #542 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #282 Gaku, his ninken, Doutou Akimichi and a fourth shinobi were part of a team which was led by Minato Namikaze during a conflict with Kumogakure. In his team, Gaku was responsible for short-range combat. In one of the battles, his team clashed with Kumogakure's A–B Combo. During Minato's fight with A and Killer B, Gaku expressed his shock over the latter's jinchuuriki transformation. Directly afterward, Gaku and his comrades received a signal to retreat, leading him to inform Minato that they are pulling back for the moment. (Source: Narutopedia)

286426.name: Akemaru
286426.about: Akemaru is a ninken from Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan. Anime debut: Boruto Episode #93 Light Novel debut: Naruto Shinden: Parent and Child Day Akemaru resembles Akamaru who is based on a Great Pyrenees, though rather than being white, Akemaru has red fur, similar to when Akamaru eats soldier pills. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286432.name: Chamaru
286432.about: Chamaru is a ninken from Konohagakure's Inuzuka clan and Akita Inuzuka's partner. Manga debut: Boruto Chapter #18 Anime debut: Boruto Episode #183 At some point in time, Chamaru lost his right hind leg during a mission which Katasuke Toono replaced with a prosthetic, leading his partner, Akita, to join the village's Scientific Ninja Weapons Team. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286435.name: Haku's Father
286435.about: He was a simple farmer and the father of Haku. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #29 Anime debut: Naruto Episode #17 Light Novel debut: Naruto: Innocent Heart, Demonic Blood (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286440.name: Kaguya Clan Patriarch
286440.about: He was the head of the Kaguya Clan. Anime debut: Naruto Episode #126 (Source: Narutopedia)

286454.name: Yotsuki, Kiyoi
286454.about: Kiyoi Yotsuki is a shinobi from Kumogakure and a member of the Yotsuki clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #408 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #142 (Source: Narutopedia)

286458.name: Nowaki
286458.about: Nowaki was once the leader of the Lightning Group. At the time, he went by the name Fuushin (風心). Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #484 Light Novel debut: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise Nowaki is a talented shinobi, having proven so by excelling in the Coliseum where wealthy collectors pit their ninja against each other. He is also skilled enough to briefly hold his own against Sasuke Uchiha. Nowaki possessed the Typhoon Release kekkei genkai – a powerful variation of Wind Release. With it, he could easily conjure powerful winds to mow down or otherwise limit his enemy's field of vision. With effort, he could also use a much stronger variation of the technique, having shown to not only dwarf Sasuke's Complete Body — Susanoo but also being capable of briefly forcing it to the defensive. The storms Nowaki can create using his kekkei genkai are severe enough to cover an entire island. (Source: Narutopedia)

286459.name: Uzumaki, Ashina
286459.about: Ashina Uzumaki was the leader of the Uzumaki Clan during the founding of Konohagakure. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #500 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #247 In the anime, he and his clan met with Hashirama and the Senju Clan in order to deal with a gigantic beast which was on the loose. Using his prowess in fuuinjutsu, the Uzumaki's leader was able to seal away the beast once it was cornered. Like members of his clan, Ashina specialised in fuuinjutsu. He was unrivalled in the handling of fuuinjutsu, and was even said to be the forefather of Konoha's fuuinjutsu. He was seen in the anime proficient enough to seal a beast within moments. He was also presumably skilled in kenjutsu as he carried two swords strapped to his back. Also, as a member of the Uzumaki clan, Ashina had an extraordinarily powerful life force, allowing him to remain an active shinobi well into his sixties. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286462.name: First Animal Path
286462.about: He was a shinobi of the Fuuma Clan. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #371 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #127 Though not much about his abilities are known, he was capable of singlehandedly wiping out a peaceful village. As a member of the Fūma clan, he was skilled in the usage of giant shuriken. (Source: Narutopedia)

286463.name: Tsuchigumo Chief
286463.about: He is the chief of the hidden village of the Tsuchigumo Clan. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #145 (Source: Narutopedia)

286464.name: Haato
286464.about: Haato was a former student of En no Gyouja and the father of Shiranami. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #148 Hotaru has stated that Haato was very skilled in ninjutsu. He could use the Tsuchigumo Clan kinjutsu, which was strong enough to destroy an entire village. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286465.name: Kanna
286465.about: Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #466 Kanna was taught to use Ninshuu by Asura and discovered she had a talent for healing chakra and was taught the Mystical Palm Technique. (Source: Narutopedia)

286527.name: Asura Path
286527.about: This man was a shinobi Jiraiya met during his journey to find his disciple. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #379 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #127 (Source: Narutopedia)

286531.name: Human Path
286531.about: This man was a shinobi of Takigakure. Following his death, he became the Human Path of the Six Paths of Pain. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #376 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #127 (Source: Narutopedia)

286532.name: Preta Path
286532.about: This man was a shinobi and a farmer of Kusagakure. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #376 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #127 (Source: Narutopedia)

286536.name: Naraka Path
286536.about: This man was a priest of an unknown village. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #379 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #127 (Source: Narutopedia)

286809.name: Genji
286809.about: Genji is an Elder of Kirigakure. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #454 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #199 Background: Genji spent much of his lifetime contributing to Kirigakure's development. He holds as much importance within the village as its Mizukage and his advice is sought for when it comes to the villages most important matters, essentially making him the law of Kirigakure. In the anime, when Tsunade sent an invitation for Kirigakure to join the Chuunin Exams co-hosted by Konohagakure and Sunagakure, Genji suggested for Kirigakure not to take part, taking Ao's advice to instead focus on the village's internal affairs. (Source: Narutopedia)

286825.name: Gotta
286825.about: Gotta was a member, and seemingly the leader of the Iburi clan. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #352 (Source: Narutopedia)

286827.name: Tenzou
286827.about: Tenzō was a member of the Iburi clan and the younger brother of Yukimi. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #354 (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

286991.name: Saya
286991.about: Saya is a kunoichi from Sunagakure and a teammate of Sana and Mamushi. Anime debut: Naruto Shipuuden Episode #398 Personality: Saya is a very arrogant and sadistic kunoichi, revelling in finding new prey; this also extends to her teammates if they displease her. She is also very domineering, making her teammates refer to her as "Lady" (お嬢さま, Ojou-sama) and follow all her orders. She has a strong superiority-complex, believing herself superior to her enemies and refuses to believe herself capable of ever losing. When people challenge that view, she enters a hysterical state, compelled to make the person pay. Saya is also shown to have a very strong attachment to her ninja-puppet and all things she deems cute, her attachment to her puppet extends to the point of masquerading like it for a prolonged period of time. Abilities: Ninjutsu Saya uses a unique style of the Puppet Technique. Her puppet is a very simple and small doll. While controlling her puppet in the traditional sense through Chakra Threads, her tactic is not to attack her enemies with her doll, but to gather a sample of the enemies' hair, allowing her to then link her mind with the target with her Puppet Imitation Technique and thereby remotely control the target similar to the Yamanaka clan's secret techniques. Saya is also capable of travelling through the ground and creating sand dolls out of pre-existing sand. Similarly to Kankurou, Saya can switch places with her puppet using the Body Replacement Technique. Say

287005.name: Sana
287005.about: Sana is a kunoichi from Sunagakure and a teammate of Saya and Mamushi. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #398 Personality: Much like her teammates, Sana is an arrogant and sadistic kunoichi. At the same time, she is very submissive before Saya, referring to her as "Elder Sister" (お姉さま, Onee-sama). Abilities: Sana is skilled in the use of a kunai, combining it with close-range fighting. She is also quite skilled in sand manipulation, being capable of creating a vast sandstorm and cloaking an ally with pre-existing sand to provide additional defence and better mask their presence. Sana is also able to sense chakra, quickly noticing when a person's chakra reserves increase. Sana, alongside her team, participated in the joint Chuunin Exams. (Source: Narutopedia)

287007.name: Mamushi
287007.about: Mamushi is a shinobi from Sunagakure and a teammate of Sana and Saya. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #398 Personality: Mamushi appears somewhat deranged, loving the notion of battling and violence. At the same time, he is very submissive before Saya, to the point where he refers to her as "Lady" (お嬢さま, Ojou-sama). Mamushi is also easily intimidated by her, as he shirks away, when she is enraged. Abilities: Mamushi seems to favour close and mid-range combat, fighting with long snakes he has hidden in his sleeve. The snakes are venomous, injecting paralysing venom in his opponents. Mamushi, alongside his team, participated in the joint Chuunin Exams. (Source: Narutopedia)

287010.name: Tsukune
287010.about: Tsukune is an academy student from Konohagakure. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #494 Personality: Tsukune is a troublemaker playing pranks on his instructors along with his fellow classmates, Sansho and Mibuna. Like Naruto in his youth he pulls pranks so that he can be acknowledged to the point he even stole what he thought to be the Scroll of Seals. He appears to be a bit of an airhead as he easily fell for Iruka's taunt and admitted to the vandalism. Later, because of Iruka, Tsukune wants to become the Hokage and surpass Naruto. Tsukune, Sansho, and Mibuna perform some vandalism around the village. When Iruka catches them in the act, they claim to only be playing hide-and-seek, but he tricks them into confessing. Iruka remarks that Naruto Uzumaki was a much bigger delinquent when he was a student, which Tsukune and the others don't believe. Later, after finding out that Naruto once stole the Scroll of Seals, Tsukune also steals it. Iruka tracks him to the Hokage Rock with help from Sansho and Mibuna. Recognising that Tsukune just wants attention, Iruka apologises for comparing him to previous students. Tsukune promises to try harder in the future. (Source: Narutopedia)

287012.name: Momo
287012.about: Momo is one of the many ninneko living in Sora-ku. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #498 Light Novel debut: Konoha Hiden: The Perfect Day for a Wedding (Source: Narutopedia)

287048.name: Gamariki
287048.about: Gamariki is a toad from Mount Myouboku. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #91 Movie debut: Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie Background: After setting off to train with Jiraiya, Naruto was first trained to recognise and disperse genjutsu. In order to do this, Jiraiya summoned Gamariki who used his Genjutsu Kiss on him, sending him into a world of illusions. In attempting to release the genjutsu, Naruto unintentionally ended up releasing chakra much in the same manner as his Rasengan, knocking Gamariki into a canal and knocking him out. It was revealed that this was the reason the two dislike each other. Personality: Gamariki is predominantly very flamboyant in his actions, often making extensive use of bodily gestures to bring his feelings across. In the Japanese version, he also has a tendency to refer to persons with the suffix "-chan" (ちゃん) in a manner that would be deemed cute. On the other hand when he became serious his voice that was normally high-pitched would take on a deep, serious tone which is assumed to be his normal voice. Despite this very flamboyant nature, he could be very serious when situations called for it. Abilities: Gamariki is quite the capable toad, being able to restrict or knockout an opponent with his Whip of Love. He can utilise the Water Release nature transformation to use techniques such as the Water Release: Water Gun, which he could use in conjunction with his summoner to produce a more devastating attack. He has also shown to be proficien

287053.name: Gamatama
287053.about: Gamatama is a tadpole from Mount Myouboku. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #429 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #162 Background: Due to not having the combat ability to yet form a contract with shinobi, Gamatama is entrusted as a name-registration clerk on Mount Myouboku. (Source: Narutopedia)

287117.name: Genbu
287117.about: Genbu was a minister in the Land of That. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #460 (Source: Narutopedia)

287118.name: Suzaku
287118.about: Suzaku was a minister in the Land of That, ages before the establishment of ninja. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #460 (Source: Narutopedia)

287197.name: Gamaden
287197.about: Gamaden is an elite toad of Mount Myouboku. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #429 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #162 (Source: Narutopedia)

287199.name: Gamagorou
287199.about: Gamagorou is a giant toad that resides on Mount Myouboku. Anime debut: Boruto Episode #4 Light Novel debut: The New Leaves Soaring Through the Blue Sky! (Source: Narutopedia)

287200.name: Gama
287200.about: Gama is the first toad named in the series, debuting alongside Jiraiya. This toad seems to be the keeper of the Toad Summoning contract scroll. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #90 Anime debut: Naruto Episode #52 Personality: Gama has not yet been seen talking, only croaking once or twice and mainly in the anime, so his personality is mostly unknown. However, he seems to be deeply loyal to Jiraiya, following him around and immediately obeying his orders; he was also the only summon shown to strike the same pose as Jiraiya. Appearance: Gama is a very large toad, enough for Jiraiya to ride on his back. His orange skin is covered in blue markings, he has bandages wrapped around his body and left foreleg, and wears a necklace with seven large beads on it, with the kanji for "loyalty" (忠, chuu) on the central, largest one. It is also shown that he has three swirl-like marking in the middle of his left palm which are similar to the one's sometimes portrayed in Jiraiya's. In battle, he is almost always seen wearing samurai armour, composed of a plate cuirass and arm-guards paired with traditional samurai pauldrons. (Source: Narutopedia) No voice actors have been added to this character. Help improve our database by searching for a voice actor, and adding this character to their roles .

287219.name: Mitsuo
287219.about: Mitsuo was a former thief and a follower of Hagoromo Ootsutsuki. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #464 (Source: Narutopedia)

287220.name: Middle School Player
287220.about: Appears in episode 132. Plays a soccer match against Karin and her friends.

287237.name: Haori
287237.about: Haori was a resident of the Land of Ancestors during the reign of Kaguya Ootsutsuki. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #461 (Source: Narutopedia)

287678.name: Kamano, Saisu
287678.about: Saisu Kamano is a chuunin of Konohagakure. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #423 Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #159 Abilities: While his abilities are mostly unknown, in the manga he was shown wielding a collapsible kusarigama, while in the anime he was wielding a collapsible kama, indicating that he has some skill with wielding bladed weapons. The anime indicates that he was trained in the usage of the weapon from very early on in his Academy days. (Source: Narutopedia)

287679.name: Dokan
287679.about: Dokan is a genin of Konohagakure. He was an academy student during the time Itachi Uchiha attended his first year at the academy. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #452 Abilities: During his time at the academy, Dokan showed great physical prowess, able to shatter the ground with his fist. (Source: Narutopedia)

287776.name: Mecha-Naruto
287776.about: Mecha-Naruto is a mechanized, robotic replica of Naruto Uzumaki that appears in Naruto Shippuuden anime filler episodes and various Naruto video games. He is not part of the original manga story but is featured in anime-exclusive content and game tie-ins. (Source: Narutopedia)

290311.name: Kouichi's Mother
290311.about: Kouichi Hirose's Mother is an unnamed tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. She is the wife of Kouichi's Father and the mother of Ayana Hirose and Koichi Hirose. She is tricked into believing Tamami Kobayashi's lies about her son, causing her guilt to amplify due to Tamami's Stand, The Lock. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290312.name: Hirose, Ayana
290312.about: Ayana Hirose is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. Ayana is the older sister of Koichi Hirose and the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. Hirose, and she is in her final year at an all-girls high school. She and her mother are attacked by Tamami Kobayashi, who amplifies their guilt with his Stand, The Lock. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290313.name: Yoshioka
290313.about: Yoshioka is a businessman who is seen talking to his boss on his cellphone. He is instructed to "do as planned" when receiving an important call one minute later. The call would grant a business opportunity worth one billion yen. If he missed the call, Yoshioka would be fired by his boss. Seemingly nervous, Yoshioka agrees but his phone is stolen by Josuke immediately. Unaware of what just happened, he continues talking to his hand before he notices his phone is gone, and is then anguished over the loss of one billion yen and his job. As Josuke grabbed the phone too hard, it ended up breaking. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290314.name: Okura, Minako
290314.about: Minako Okura is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. During an investigation, Hayato Kawajiri witnesses her and her boyfriend Satoru Nakae being killed by Yoshikage Kira. (Source: Jojo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290315.name: Nakae, Satoru
290315.about: Satoru Nakae is a tertiary character featured in the fourth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series, Diamond is Unbreakable. During the investigation, Hayato Kawajiri witnessed him and his girlfriend Minako Okura being killed by Yoshikage Kira. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290316.name: Disfigured Delinquent
290316.about: These four delinquents are seniors at Josuke Higashikata's school known for walking around Morioh bullying freshmen. They demand that Koichi Hirose and Josuke greet them as part of the "the rules of school" or they would end up in the hospital just like three guys who previously refused to do it. When Josuke ignores them because he was busy trying to conquer his fear of reptiles by getting close to a turtle, one of the delinquents grabs the turtle and throws it away, smashing its shell open. Josuke was trying not to attract attention and even apologizes, but decides to retaliate after one of them mocks his hair. He immediately uses Crazy Diamond to punch the guy's face, "fixing" his nose into a different shape. The delinquents then run away in fear of getting beaten up. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290317.name: Tomoko's Catcaller
290317.about: A random man who accosts Tomoko Higashikata as she walks down the street. He attempts to seem friendly, all the while drooling over her. In response, she slams his face down into his own car door knocking out his teeth. He then demands Ryohei Higashikata arrest her, who refuses. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia)

290733.name: K
290733.about: K is a chuunin of Kumogakure and was partnered with J. K has short, spiky brown hair and black eyes. He wears the standard uniform of the Kumogakure shinobi including flak jacket, a white forehead protector and shin guards. K holds a great deal of respect for his partner, J, and always moves alongside him when possible. (Source: Narutopedia)

290758.name: Komugi
290758.about: Komugi is a genin from Konohagakure. Komugi has spiky black hair and a small, pointed goatee. He has squinting eyes and wears a simple two-toned t-shirt, pants and the village's forehead protector. Komugi seemed to get happy easily even crying tears of joy when he found his team passed the first part of his second Chuunin Exams. He, like his teammates, is overconfident in his abilities. He has some taijutsu skills as he fought hand-to-hand against the Sunagakure ninja on the night before the exam, not finishing the fight with some girl when Fuu burst into the hall. At the same time, not long after this, he got a kick in the face from Ajisai. Like the members of his team, Komugi is quite tough and fast, being one of the thirty people who managed to reach Sunagakure from Konohagakure in three days. (Source: Narutopedia)

290759.name: Taizou
290759.about: Taizou was an inhabitant of the Land of Ancestors and a close friend of Ashura Ootsutsuki. Taizou had short, spiky black hair with a brown patch above his forehead and black eyes. As a child, he wore a grey apron-like cloak tied over his stomach with a white sash. Under it, he wore a plain, khaki shirt. He also wore plain pants and brown sandals. As an adult, he wore a light-grey cloak tied over his stomach, a dark-grey apron tied around his waist with a brown belt, light-grey pants, grey sandals and white bandages wrapped around his wrists and ankles. During his journey alongside Ashura, he wore a straw hat, a white cape that also covered his head, a scarf and a grey sash tied around his torso. Taizou was a carefree man showing lots of initiative. He loved his mother dearly, going as far as involving his best friend in committing a crime against his knowledge to heal her, although he regretted this decision afterwards. He was very loyal towards his friend Ashura and accompanied him for a long time and during many hardships, even with Ashura resisting in the first place. Even though he was offended by the villagers' initial hostility, he quickly brushed away his anger while helping Ashura. He himself admitted not to be a big thinker, but made this fault up by always being supportive, giving his best no matter the situation. While originally refraining from learning the art as his mother was against it, Taizou eventually chose to learn Ninshuu from Ashura. After months of stud

291848.name: Tsubusa
291848.about: Tsubusa is a chuunin from Sunagakure. Tsubusa has short, black hair and most of his face is concealed by a mask. He wears the standard attire of the Suna-nin, which includes its forehead protector, its flak jacket, and a turban along with a metal face guard. He is said to have excellent eyes and can discover enemy forces several miles away. It was due to this ability that he was tasked to patrol at Sunagakure's gate and was indeed the first one to discover the approaching Akatsuki members, even when there were many other jounin and Anbu present. (Source: Narutopedia)

291851.name: Suname
291851.about: Suname is a chuunin of Sunagakure. He has short brown hair that is mostly concealed under a ghutrah. He wears the standard attire of the Suna-nin, which includes its flak jacket and its forehead protector. He also has small dark-colored eyes. (Source: Narutopedia)

291854.name: Isago
291854.about: Isago is a jounin of Sunagakure. Isago has an angular face with a strong jawline and troughs under his eyes. He wears the standard attire of a Suna ninja inclusive of a ghutrah, flak jacket and forehead protector. Isago is most likely a very skilled shinobi since he is the right-hand man to , who plays an important role in Sunagakure's advisory council. (Source: Narutopedia)

291860.name: Natori
291860.about: Natori is a chuunin of Konohagakure that works in the Konoha Aviary. Natori's most notable feature are the lines around his eyes that are turned up at the ends. He has short brown hair and wears his forehead protector like a bandanna along with the standard Konoha shinobi outfit, minus the flak jacket. He also tends to wear a thick set of bandages around his left arm for birds to perch on without damaging his arm. It is said that his speed and accuracy are outstanding compared to the rest of the Aviary. (Source: Narutopedia)

291863.name: Yurika
291863.about: Yurika is a Konohagakure kunoichi and a member of the Konoha Cryptology Team. She has short, straight brown hair and eyes of the same color. She wears a shade of pink lipstick along with a short dress with the kanji for "number" (号, goh), which itself comes from the word "cypher" (暗号, angoh) on the back of it, a white belt around her waist and a pair of low-heeled sandals. (Source: Narutopedia)

291864.name: Gouza
291864.about: Gouza is a Senior from Sunagakure. Gouza has dark eyes and brown hair which is obscured by the ghutrah he wears. He has a full beard and wears the standard attire of the Sunagakure Senior which consists of a dark kimono under a light-colored haori and a poncho. He has been described as a rational, level-headed, and calm individual. As a member of the advisory council, he is most likely one of Sunagakure's wisest shinobi. (Source: Narutopedia)

291865.name: Ryuusa
291865.about: Ryuusa is a senior from Sunagakure. He has served his village for many years. Ryuusa has dark eyes, fairly thick eyebrows, and a strong jawline. He wears the standard attire of the Sunagakure Seniors. His speech and conduct are very prudent, allowing him to act with calm judgement. His actions are always based on his deliberate judgement. As a member of the advisory council, he is most likely one of Sunagakure's wisest shinobi. (Source: Narutopedia)

291866.name: Sekka
291866.about: Sekka is a talented medical-nin of Sunagakure. Sekka has dark eyes and thick eyebrows. He wears what is seemingly the standard uniform for medical ninja in Sunagakure which entails a red tunic with a white poncho-like collar which he wears along with a ghutrah and white forehead protector. Sekka is a talented medical-nin who is said to have saved numerous lives in the past. (Source: Narutopedia)

291867.name: Ryoukan
291867.about: Ryoukan is a medical-nin of Sunagakure. Ryoukan has dark eyes and thin eyebrows. He wears what is seemingly the standard uniform for medical ninja in Sunagakure which entails a red tunic with a white poncho-like collar which he wears along with a ghutrah and a white forehead protector. Ryoukan seems to get frustrated a lot when he is unable to help his fellow comrades. He was filled with regret at not being able to help . Ryoukan is a talented medical-nin, but he along with his mentor Sekka were unable to help Kankurou, something he deeply regretted. As a medical-nin, he has a good chakra control in general. (Source: Narutopedia)

293634.name: Commander Nezi
293634.about: Commander Nezi is a Machine Mutant created by Dr. Myuu, and is the leader of the elite Sigma Force.

293635.name: Bisu
293635.about: Bisu is a Machine Mutant created by Dr. Myuu and part of the Sigma Force.

293637.name: Ribet
293637.about: Ribet is a Machine Mutant who, along with his partners Nezi, Natt and Bizu, make up General Rilldo's top mercenary team, the Sigma Force.

293639.name: Natt
293639.about: Natt is one of the members of General Rilldo's top mercenary force, the Sigma Force, alongside Nezi, Bizu and Ribet. They are called upon when Dr. Myuu demands "results'.

293640.name: Super Σ
293640.about: Super Mega Cannon Sigma is the fusion of Commander Nezi, Ribet and Bizu.

294140.name: Agari
294140.about: Agari is the wife of Giichi. Manga debut: Naruto Chapter #31 Anime debut: Naruto Episode #18

294284.name: Uchiha, Taiko
294284.about: He was a character in Jiraiya's novel within Tsunade's Infinite Tsukuyomi dream. Anime debut: Naruto Shippuuden Episode #443

295713.name: Zuunama
295713.about: Zuunama is a giant monster living in an underground cave near a volcano on planet Gelbo.

298090.name: Gothic Newscaster
298090.about: The Gothic Newscaster is a newscaster that reported the incident in Pata City involving the former Squadron Leader Cheetu. (Source: Hunterpedia)
